Title: 1. Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
description: After the Empire overpowers the Rebel Alliance, Luke Skywalker begins training with Jedi Master Yoda, while Darth Vader and bounty hunter Boba Fett pursue his friends across the galaxy.

Title: 2. Superman II
description: Superman agrees to sacrifice his powers to start a relationship with Lois Lane, unaware that three Kryptonian criminals he inadvertently released are conquering Earth.

Title: 3. 9 to 5
description: Three secretaries turn the tables on their obnoxious boss.

Title: 4. Stir Crazy
description: Set up and wrongfully accused, two best friends are sent to prison for a crime they didn't commit. However, no prison cell can keep them locked in a cage.

Title: 5. Airplane!
description: After the crew becomes sick with food poisoning, a neurotic ex-fighter pilot must safely land a commercial airplane full of passengers.

Title: 6. Any Which Way You Can
description: A trucker turned prize fighter, his brother and their pet orangutan have a series of misadventures involving the mob, corrupt cops, motorcycle gangs and pretty dames.

Title: 7. Private Benjamin
description: A sheltered young high-society woman joins the United States Army on a whim and finds herself in a trickier situation than she ever expected.

Title: 8. Coal Miner's Daughter
description: The fictionalized life of singer Loretta Lynn, a girl who rose from humble beginnings to become a country music star in the 1960s/70s.

Title: 9. Smokey and the Bandit II
description: The Bandit goes on another cross-country run, transporting an elephant from Florida to Texas. And, once again, Sheriff Buford T. Justice is on his tail.

Title: 10. The Blue Lagoon
description: During the Victorian period, two preteen cousins are shipwrecked on a tropical island in the South Pacific and enjoy a simple life together until puberty complicates matters.

Title: 11. The Blues Brothers
description: Jake Blues rejoins his brother Elwood after being released from prison, but the duo has just days to reunite their old R&B band and save the Catholic home where the two were raised, outrunning the police as they tear through Chicago.

Title: 12. Ordinary People
description: The accidental death of the older son of an affluent family deeply strains the relationships among the bitter mother, the good-natured father and the guilt-ridden younger son.

Title: 13. Popeye
description: The adventures of the famous sailor man and his friends in the seaside town of Sweethaven.

Title: 14. The Shining
description: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter, where a sinister presence influences the father into violence. At the same time, his psychic son sees horrifying forebodings from both the past and the future.

Title: 15. Urban Cowboy
description: Bud is a young man from the country who learns about life and love in a Houston bar.

Title: 16. Seems Like Old Times
description: Wrongfully accused of a bank robbery, a writer seeks the help of his ex-wife, who is now married to the soon-to-be Attorney General of California.

Title: 17. Cheech and Chong's Next Movie
description: Cheech and Chong live in a decrepit old house and drive their neighbour crazy with their loud music, weed smoking and general anarchy and slacker view on life. Then Chong meets Cheech's Texan cousin Red and things kick up a notch.

Title: 18. Caddyshack
description: Something fishy is going on at the elitist Bushwood Country Club, and the scheming president of the clubhouse, Judge Elihu Smails, has something to do with it. But suave golf guru Ty Webb and distasteful, filthy rich construction magnate Al Czervik are on to him. Meanwhile, young caddie Danny Noonan struggles to get his life back on track, and the only way to do it is by winning the demanding Caddie Day golf tournament, a prestigious competition that can earn him a scholarship from the judge himself. Now, war breaks out and all bets are off. Will Danny ever make his dream come true? Does he know that a subterranean menace is threatening to put in jeopardy everyone's plans?

Title: 19. Friday the 13th
description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

Title: 20. Brubaker
description: The new warden of a small prison farm in Arkansas tries to clean it up of corruption after initially posing as an inmate.

Title: 21. Little Darlings
description: Two fifteen-year-old girls from different sides of the tracks compete to see who will be the first to lose their virginity while at a summer camp.

Title: 22. Dressed to Kill
description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.

Title: 23. The Gods Must Be Crazy
description: A comic allegory about a traveling Bushman who encounters modern civilization and its stranger aspects, including a clumsy scientist and a band of revolutionaries.

Title: 24. The Jazz Singer
description: The son of a Jewish Cantor must defy the traditions of his religious father in order to pursue his dream of being a popular singer.

Title: 25. Flash Gordon
description: Football player Flash Gordon and his comrades travel to the planet Mongo and find themselves fighting the tyranny of Ming the Merciless to save Earth from its eventual destruction.

Title: 26. The Elephant Man
description: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily-disfigured and mistreated young man working as a sideshow freak, who gradually reveals his capacity for kindness, intelligence and sophistication.

Title: 27. Bronco Billy
description: An idealistic, modern-day cowboy struggles to keep his Wild West show afloat in the face of hard luck and waning interest.

Title: 28. Raging Bull
description: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

Title: 29. Xanadu
description: A struggling artist living in Los Angeles meets a girl who may hold the key to his happiness.

Title: 30. American Gigolo
description: Los Angeles escort Julian Kay is accused of a murder which he did not commit.

Title: 31. My Bodyguard
description: When Clifford Peache enrolls in a new high school and is harassed by a bully named Moody, he acquires the services of the school's most feared kid, the sullen Ricky Linderman, as a bodyguard.

Title: 32. The Fog
description: Local legend tells of a ship lured on to the rocks of Antonio Bay being enveloped by a supernatural cloud as it sank; the myth says that when this mysterious fog returns, the victims will rise up from the depths seeking vengeance.

Title: 33. Fame
description: Four teenagers must prove their mettle as they begin their journey at the New York High School of Performing Arts. They must navigate through heartbreak, school work, adolescence and challenges.

Title: 34. Altered States
description: A psycho-physiologist experiments with drugs and a sensory-deprivation tank and has visions he believes are genetic memories.

Title: 35. Cruising
description: A police officer goes undercover in the underground S&M gay subculture of New York City to catch a serial killer who is preying on gay men.

Title: 36. The Octagon
description: A martial artist must defeat a plan by ninjas to create a worldwide training camp for terrorists.

Title: 37. Herbie Goes Bananas
description: The adorable little VW helps its owners break up a counterfeiting ring in Mexico.

Title: 38. Honeysuckle Rose
description: Buck is a country singer on the road caught in a romantic triangle with Viv and Lily, the daughter of his longtime musical sidekick.

Title: 39. Rough Cut
description: Two sophisticated jewel thieves join forces to steal $30 million in uncut jewels. Despite a continuous exchange of quips they eventually become romantically involved.

Title: 40. The Final Countdown
description: A modern aircraft carrier is thrown back in time to 1941 near Hawaii, just hours before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.

Title: 41. The Hunter
description: Bounty hunter Ralph "Papa" Thorson is receiving death threats from a criminal he helped put away. This while his girlfriend is about to give birth, an event he isn't looking forward to.

Title: 42. Hero at Large
description: A struggling actor buying milk stops a robbery while wearing a superhero uniform, promoting a movie. The unknown hero decides to try again. Can he impress his cute neighbor?

Title: 43. The Long Riders
description: The origins, exploits and the ultimate fate of the Jesse James gang is told in a sympathetic portrayal of the bank robbers made up of brothers who begin their legendary bank raids because of revenge.

Title: 44. The Island
description: Journalist Blair Maynard takes his son Justin to investigate pirate activity off the Florida coast. A plane crash strands them on an island of modern-day pirates, who brainwash Justin. Blair tries to rescue him and take him home.

Title: 45. First Family
description: Bob Newhart stars as President Manfred Link in this zany, wonderfully-cast comedy from veteran funnyman Buck Henry ("Heaven Can Wait", "The Graduate").

Title: 46. Prom Night
description: At a high-school senior prom, a masked killer stalks four teenagers who were responsible for the accidental death of a classmate six years previously.

Title: 47. The Nude Bomb
description: Maxwell Smart is recalled to duty to help fight a villian who threatens to detonate a weapon that destroys clothing.

Title: 48. Oh, God! Book II
description: A young girl receives a divine message and starts a campaign to promote faith. Her family and teacher, skeptical of her claims, try to stop her efforts. She persists despite their opposition, convinced of her heavenly calling.

Title: 49. The Competition
description: Paul Dietrich, at almost 30 years old, is a fading piano prodigy. Heidi Schoonover is a talented young pianist with a promising future. When Paul hears of an upcoming competition that could make his career, he dedicates himself to winning.

Title: 50. Wholly Moses!
description: An all-star comedy cast hams it up in this hilarious Biblical spoof.

Title: 51. The Last Married Couple in America
description: Mari and Jeff Thompson start to doubt their own marriage when every couple they know separate.

Title: 52. Atlantic City
description: In a corrupt city, a small-time gangster and the estranged wife of a pot dealer find themselves thrown together in an escapade of love, money, drugs and danger.

Title: 53. Used Cars
description: When the old owner of a dilapidated used-car lot dies due to foul play, his ambitious young hot-shot salesman and his colleagues vow to save the property from falling into the hands of the owner's treacherous used-car rival brother.

Title: 54. The Mirror Crack'd
description: Miss Jane Marple comes to solve the mystery when a local woman is poisoned, but a visiting movie star seems to have been the intended victim.

Title: 55. The Last Flight of Noah's Ark
description: When a plane carrying various animals makes a forced landing on a desert island, the only chance to escape is to convert the plane into a boat.

Title: 56. The Fiendish Plot of Dr. Fu Manchu
description: When Fu's age-regressing elixir vitae is spilled by a hapless flunky, Fu Manchu sends his lackeys to round up supplies for a fresh batch of elixir, including a precious jewel, which prompts a team of agents to track him down.

Title: 57. Stardust Memories
description: While attending a retrospective of his work, a filmmaker recalls his life and his loves: the inspirations for his films.

Title: 58. The Hollywood Knights
description: Led by their comedic leader, Turk, the Hollywood Knights car club raise hell throughout Beverly Hills on Halloween Night, 1965.

Title: 59. Serial
description: It's the end of the seventies. Hippies are assimilating, women are becoming aware and men are becoming confused and ineffective. Don't expect to be able to keep track of all the names.

Title: 60. Somewhere in Time
description: A Chicago playwright uses self-hypnosis to travel back in time and meet the actress whose vintage portrait hangs in a grand hotel.

Title: 61. Saturn 3
description: Two lovers stationed at a remote base in the asteroid belt of Saturn are intruded upon by a difficult technocrat from Earth and his charge: a malevolent eight foot tall robot.

Title: 62. Tribute
description: A shallow Broadway press agent learns he is dying just as his son by his ex-wife arrives for a visit.

Title: 63. The Formula
description: The synthetic fuel production formula, invented by the Nazis at the end of World War II, is sought after by some who aim to sell it, and by others who wish to destroy it.

Title: 64. Battle Creek Brawl
description: A young Asian-American martial artist is forced to participate in a brutal formal street-fighting competition.

Title: 65. The Awakening
description: An archeologist discovers his daughter is possessed by the spirit of an Egyptian queen. To save mankind he must destroy her.

Title: 66. Fatso
description: An overweight bachelor is fat, 40 and fed up--to the gills--but when his obese cousin Sal dies at 39, he must finally come to terms with his own weight problem.

Title: 67. How to Beat the High Cost of Living
description: A caper comedy about three suburban housewives who, in order to beat inflation and subsidize their alimony checks, plot to steal $1 million from a large plastic ball which is displayed in a local shopping center.

Title: 69. Foxes
description: A group of four teenage girls come of age in the asphalt desert of Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley arranged with a blazing soundtrack and endless drinking, drugs and sex.

Title: 70. The Big Red One
description: A hardened sergeant and the four core members of his infantry unit try to survive World War II as they move from battle to battle throughout Europe.

Title: 71. The Stunt Man
description: While running from the police, a paranoid Vietnam veteran stumbles on a film shoot, and accidentally causes a stuntman to drown. The domineering film director takes him under his wing, and hires him as a replacement stuntman.

Title: 72. La Cage aux Folles II
description: The titular gay couple become involved with local cops and foreign spies when one of them unwittingly obtains a roll of stolen microfilm.

Title: 73. Where the Buffalo Roam
description: Semi-biographical film based on the experiences of gonzo journalist Hunter S. Thompson.

Title: 74. The Gong Show Movie
description: A week in the life of "The Gong Show" host and creator Chuck Barris who lives through a series of outrageous competitors, stressful situations, a nervous breakdown and other comical characters involved in his life and work on the TV show.

Title: 75. Motel Hell
description: A seemingly friendly farmer and his sister kidnap unsuspecting travelers and bury them alive, using them to create the "special meat" they are famous for.

Title: 76. Little Miss Marker
description: A gruff bookie's life is turned upside-down when he gets a 6-year-old kid as collateral for a bet.

Title: 77. Oh Heavenly Dog
description: A murdered detective must avenge his murder after he is reincarnated as a dog.

Title: 78. The Dogs of War
description: Mercenary James Shannon, on a reconnaissance job to the African nation of Zangaro, is tortured and deported. He returns to lead a coup.

Title: 79. Divine Madness
description: Movie comedy queen Bette Midler reigns supreme in this rocking, rolling concert movie bash. The Divine Miss M at her trashiest, flashiest, heavenly best!

Title: 80. In God We Trust (or Gimme That Prime Time Religion)
description: Raised in a Trappist monastery, the innocent Brother Ambrose sets out to find money to save the bankrupt monastery. His education in worldliness is provided by a hooker. He eventually petitions G. O. D. For the cash.

Title: 81. The Watcher in the Woods
description: When a family moves to a country home, the young girls experience strange happenings that have a link to an occult event years past.

Title: 82. He Knows You're Alone
description: A maniacal killer targets brides in Staten Island.

Title: 83. Coast to Coast
description: A wealthy neurotic woman escapes from a New York mental asylum, and hitches a ride back to California with a moody down-on-his-luck cowboy trucker. They fall in love with each other while on the run from bounty hunters and a repo man.

Title: 84. Willie & Phil
description: Remake of Jules et Jim following the experiences over a decade of two friends who fall in love with the same woman, enjoyably satirising the 70's through the search by the three protagonists for their identities and making sharp attacks on cultural signposts of the decade along the way. The film also studies relationships, what its director calls "wanting something permanent yet wanting to be free".

Title: 85. Melvin and Howard
description: The story of hard-luck Melvin E. Dummar, who claimed to have received a will naming him an heir to the fortune of Howard Hughes.

Title: 86. Roadie
description: A young Texas good ol' boy has a knack with electronic equipment, and that talent gets him a job as a roadie with a raucous travelling rock-and-roll show.

Title: 87. Gloria
description: When a young boy's family is killed by the mob, their tough neighbor Gloria becomes his reluctant guardian. In possession of a book that the gangsters want, the pair go on the run in New York.

Title: 88. Kagemusha: The Shadow Warrior
description: A petty thief with an utter resemblance to a samurai warlord is hired as the lord's double. When the warlord later dies the thief is forced to take up arms in his place.

Title: 89. Resurrection
description: A woman enters the afterlife briefly after a car crash that kills her husband. But she survives - and finds herself possessing strange powers.

Title: 90. Hide in Plain Sight
description: A divorced factory worker in 1967 Buffalo fights for custody of his children after his ex-wife marries a low-level mobster who enters the witness protection program, battling with government officials who seem to have little sympathy.

Title: 91. When Time Ran Out...
description: An active volcano threatens a south Pacific island resort and its guests as a power struggle ensues between the property's developer and a drilling foreman.

Title: 92. Heaven's Gate
description: During the Johnson County War in 1890 Wyoming, a sheriff born into wealth does his best to protect immigrant farmers from rich cattle interests.

Title: 93. The Last Metro
description: In occupied Paris, an actress married to a Jewish theater owner must keep him hidden from the Germans while doing both of their jobs.

Title: 94. North Sea Hijack
description: When terrorists take over two oil rigs, and threaten to blow them up if their demands are not met, an eccentric anti-terrorism expert volunteers his unique commando unit to stop them.

Title: 95. Midnight Madness
description: Leon picks college students to participate in his all night scavenger hunt. Five teams receive clues to solve leading them to the next clue site hidden in the city.

Title: 96. Loving Couples
description: Wife is cheating her husband and the husband is cheating her back with her lover's girlfriend. The two cheating couples decide to go to a resort but they unintentionally pick the same one. Hilarity ensues.

Title: 97. The Idolmaker
description: Based on the life of rock promoter/producer Bob Marcucci, who discovered, among others, Frankie Avalon and Fabian.

Title: 98. The Black Marble
description: A show dog trainer in desperate need of money kidnaps a prized show dog and demands a ransom. The case falls into the hands of a melancholic detective and his new female partner, whose personal relationship develops throughout the case.

Title: 99. Gilda Live
description: A filmed version of the Broadway show starring comedienne Gilda Radner, complete with the characters she made famous on the TV show Saturday Night Live (1975).

Title: 100. Windows
description: A weird woman admires and spies on her shy mousy neighbor with a telescope.

Title: 101. Just Tell Me What You Want
description: A married, egotistical, middle-aged corporate CEO and his mistress and protegee, who wants a more serious commitment and ends up dating a younger man, are in a casual love/hate relationship and engage in a battle of wits.

Title: 102. Bon Voyage, Charlie Brown (and Don't Come Back!!)
description: Charlie Brown and his friends travel to Europe as exchange students.

Title: 103. Carny
description: Tired of her dull job as a waitress, Donna decides to join two carnival hustlers and see what life in their field is like.

Title: 104. Why Would I Lie?
description: Cletus is a compulsive liar, though he prefers the term 'fabrication' to 'lie.' When he becomes a social worker, he's assigned the case of a boy named Jeorge (with a 'J') who was taken from his mother. Cletus sets out to reunite Jorge with his mother, but to do this, he must fabricate many a story to keep Jeorge from being adopted. In search of the mother, Cletus meets and falls in love with a women's-advice counselor.

Title: 105. Nijinsky
description: The story of Vaslav Nijinsky, who is widely believed to be one of the greatest ballet dancers of all time. Based on Romola Nijinsky's "Last Years Of Nijinski.

Title: 106. Heart Beat
description: The life and friendship among the icons of the Beat Generation: Neal Cassady, Carolyn Cassady, and Jack Kerouac.

Title: 107. One-Trick Pony
description: Jonah (Paul Simon) is a once-popular folk-rock musician trying to put together a new album in the face of an indifferent record-company executive and a talentless producer. At the same time, he's struggling to save his failing marriage.

Title: 108. Those Lips, Those Eyes
description: Stagestruck adolescent learns about love the hard way while interning in Cleveland summer stock during the early '50's.

Title: 109. A Small Circle of Friends
description: Harvard in the 60's: a time of social upheaval and student unrest. Three students bond together, challenge the system, and begin to lose their ideals.

Title: 110. Sunday Lovers
description: A sex comedy anthology containing four stories, each from a different country (England, France, the U.S., and Italy).

Title: 111. Cattle Annie and Little Britches
description: In 19th-century Oklahoma, two teen girls who love stories about outlaws are on a quest to meet and join up with them. They find a shadow of a former gang and, although disappointed, still try to help them escape from a vigorous Marshal.

Title: 112. Leo and Loree
description: Ralph Malph from Philly moves to Hollywood with dreams of making it big, amazingly hooks up with starlet-to-be, loses starlet-to-be, gets back starlet-to-be, and becomes someone.

Title: 113. The Sea Wolves
description: During World War II, British Intelligence brings a crew of ex-soldiers out of retirement, using their age as cover, to take to the seas and pull off an unlikely undercover mission in neutral Goa.

Title: 114. Babylon
description: Centres around Brindsley Forde's character Blue. He fronts a reggae sound system based in South West London (Brixton). It captures the trials and tribulations of young black youths in troubled London in the early eighties.

Title: 115. Phobia
description: A psychiatrist involved in a radical new therapy comes under suspicion when his patients are murdered, each according to their individual phobias.

Title: 116. Night of the Juggler
description: A tough New York City ex-cop relentlessly searches for his kidnapped teenage daughter who is held by a twisted psycho after mistaking her for the daughter of a wealthy businessman.

Title: 117. Every Man for Himself
description: An examination of sexual relationships, in which three protagonists interact in different combinations.

Title: 118. The King and the Mockingbird
description: A chimney sweep and a shepherdess seek to escape from the clutches of a tyrannical king.

Title: 119. Second-Hand Hearts
description: A high-spirited wife and her meekish husband hit the road to take back her kids from her previous marriage who live with her ex-inlaws.

Title: 120. City of Women
description: A male chauvinist becomes trapped in a nightmare at a feminist convention.

Title: 121. Gregory's Girl
description: Gregory is a normal teen who is infatuated with a classmate. He must work to win her affection.

Title: 122. Breaking Glass
description: A rock singer is determined to rise to the top of the profession, letting nothing stand in the way of that goal.

Title: 123. Cannibal Holocaust
description: An anthropologist ventures into the Amazon rainforest on a rescue mission, where he recovers footage shot by a film crew documenting their disastrous encounters with local cannibal tribes.

Title: 124. The Changeling
description: After experiencing tragic personal losses, a music professor rents a Seattle mansion with a troubled history.

Title: 125. The Long Good Friday
description: An up-and-coming gangster is tested by the insurgence of an unknown, very powerful threat.

Title: 126. Galaxina
description: In the 31st century, sexy blonde android Galaxina helms the crew of a space cruiser on a mission to find the Blue Star, a mystical gem that holds unlimited power.

Title: 127. Tender Cousins
description: With Adolf Hitler threatening Europe, against the backdrop of the deceptively peaceful summer of 1939, 14-year-old Julien experiences the intoxicating effects of first love, smitten with his beautiful 16-year-old cousin Julia.

Title: 128. Maniac
description: A psychopathic serial killer goes on a increasingly violent spree of murder and mutilation in New York City.

Title: 129. Inferno
description: An American student investigates the disappearance of his sister and the death of a friend, both connected from New York to Rome by an old alchemy book.

Title: 130. Pixote
description: The life of a boy on the streets of Sao Paulo, involved with crimes, prostitution, and drugs.

Title: 131. Alligator
description: A pet baby alligator is flushed down a toilet and survives in the city sewers. Twelve years later, it grows to an enormous size thanks to a diet of discarded laboratory dogs injected with growth hormones. Now, humans have entered the menu.

Title: 132. City of the Living Dead
description: A reporter and a psychic race to close the Gates of Hell after the suicide of a clergyman caused them to open, allowing the dead to rise from their graves.

Title: 133. Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur
description: Through the adventure in summer, a boy experiences meeting and parting with a friend.

Title: 134. Bad Timing
description: When a married American woman ends up in a Vienna hospital after a suicide attempt, an inspector seeks to uncover the cause and eventual demise of her torrid affair with a psychoanalyst.

Title: 135. Terror Train
description: Three years after a prank went terribly awry, the six college students responsible are targeted by a masked killer at a New Year's Eve party aboard a moving train.

Title: 136. The Party
description: This is the story about a teenage girl's first love experiences.

Title: 137. Battle Beyond the Stars
description: A farm boy recruits a band of outlaws to save the planet Akir from dark forces that threaten to wipe them out from the face of the universe. A battle stretching beyond the stars begins here.

Title: 138. Without Warning
description: Sandy and Greg are teenagers who go camping, despite warnings not to, with their friends. They soon encounter aliens, who are using the area as a hunting ground.

Title: 139. Humanoids from the Deep
description: Humanoid sea creatures start killing a fishing town's residents, and raping their women. It's up to the townsfolk and a visiting biologist to fight back and fend them off.

Title: 140. Out of the Blue
description: A young girl whose father is an ex-convict and whose mother is a junkie finds conforming difficult and seeks comfort in a quirky combination of Elvis and the punk scene.

Title: 141. Fade to Black
description: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

Title: 142. The Apple
description: In 1994, a young couple enters the world of the music industry, and subsequently the world of drugs.

Title: 143. Lion of the Desert
description: In 1929, Italian Fascist dictator Benito Mussolini appoints General Rodolfo Graziani as colonial governor to Italian Libya with orders to stamp-out all resistance from Libyan nationalists led by rebel guerrilla leader Omar Mukhtar.

Title: 144. The House on the Edge of the Park
description: Two low-life punks are invited to a party at a posh New Jersey villa and take everyone hostage after being humiliated by their snobbish guests, subjecting them to rape, torture and mayhem.

Title: 145. Times Square
description: Two ill-matched teenage girls form a punk band and soon have New York City by its ears.

Title: 146. Death Ship
description: A mysterious ghostly freighter rams and sinks a modern day cruise ship whose survivors climb aboard the freighter and discover that it is a World War II Nazi torture vessel.

Title: 147. The Night of the Hunted
description: Futuristic asylum residents in a skyscraper suffer insanity, amnesia. Blank-eyed inmates roam halls of "Black Tower" as tension escalates and bodies pile up.

Title: 148. The Taming of the Scoundrel
description: A grumpy farmer in small Italy is surprised when a beautiful city girl breaks down in the rain, surprising everyone else in his town.

Title: 149. The First Deadly Sin
description: Police inspector Edward Delaney, nearing retirement, is trying to care for his bedridden wife Barbara while he tracks a serial killer who is terrorizing New York.

Title: 150. The Burning Train
description: A dedicated railway employee's plan to introduce an express train result in sabotage.

Title: 151. Rapture
description: A low budget horror filmmaker gets in touch with an eccentric who is trying to film his consciousness during drug abuse.

Title: 152. Pepi, Luci, Bom and Other Girls Like Mom
description: Pepi is raped by the policeman who catches her growing marijuana in her apartment. She seeks revenge by getting his masochist wife to leave him.

Title: 153. Death Watch
description: In a future where dying of illness is very rare, terminally ill Katherine Mortenhoe becomes a celebrity and Roddy, a man with camera implants in his brain, secretly records her for a morbid TV show called Death Watch.

Title: 154. The Terrace
description: During a dinner in a Roman terrace, the lives and experiences of multiple characters intertwine.

Title: 155. Lightning Over Water
description: Wim Wenders abandons the shoot of one of his own films in order to help his friend and fellow director Nicholas Ray create his swan song before he dies.

Title: 156. The Ninth Configuration
description: An ex-marine psychiatrist attempts to rehabilitate his patients by indulging their fantasies, and seeks to prove the existence of a loving God to one especially troubled inmate.

Title: 157. Loulou
description: Nelly, a bored wife, leaves her husband for Loulou, an unemployed, petty criminal.

Title: 158. Rocío
description: The film shows the genesis of the El Rocío pilgrimage and unveils the economic, socio-political and religious reasons and interests that nurture the phenomenon.

Title: 159. Foolin' Around
description: A working-class boy falls for a girl from a wealthy family and must compete with a rich creep for her affections.

Title: 160. Children's Island
description: Reine lies to his mother about going to summer camp, instead staying unsupervised in Stockholm. The movie depicts his adventures and encounters around the city during summer break while his oblivious mother works.

Title: 161. Breaker Morant
description: Three Australian lieutenants are court martialed for executing prisoners as a way of deflecting attention from war crimes committed by their superior officers.

Title: 162. Emanuelle, Queen of Sados
description: A woman struggles to keep her stepdaughter from harms way after she hires an assassin to kill her husband, but the hitman turns and blackmails her for the crime.

Title: 163. Sweet Hot Lisa
description: A young and attractive woman trapped in a marriage with a husband much older than her is sexually dissatisfied. She ends up cheating on him. Still not satisfied, she ends up meeting a young man, and his two lesbian friends.

Title: 164. Shogun Assassin
description: When the wife of the Shogun's Decapitator is murdered and he is ordered to commit suicide by the paranoid Shogun, he and his four-year-old son escape and become assassins for hire, embarking on a journey of blood and violent death.

Title: 165. Hopscotch
description: Grounded with a desk job by incompetent superiors, a clever CIA agent retires and writes a tell all memoir that will embarrass his bosses, prompting him to go on the run and elude them.

Title: 166. Raise the Titanic
description: Once they said God himself couldn't sink her. Then they said no man on Earth could reach her. But an underwater research agency, headed by Admiral James Sandecker, is assigned the job of finding the doomed ship in her North Atlantic grave.

Title: 167. Nightmare City
description: Dean Miller, a reporter chasing the truth, faces a citywide outbreak after infected survivors emerge from a mysterious military arrival, forcing him to fight for survival while exposing a hidden disaster.

Title: 168. Hangar 18
description: After a UFO crashes in Arizona, due to a space collision with a NASA satellite launch, the U.S. government tries to cover-up the incident for political reasons.

Title: 169. Tom Horn
description: A former army scout is hired by ranchers to kill cattle rustlers, but he gets into trouble with corrupt officials when he's accused of killing an innocent local boy.

Title: 170. Moscow Does Not Believe in Tears
description: Three young provincial women come to Moscow in search of what people in all the capitals of the world are looking for - love, happiness and prosperity. Their destinies develop exactly as the character of each of the girls suggests.

Title: 171. Inside Moves
description: Handicapped after an unsuccessful suicide attempt, a man finds common ground in the troubled souls at a local dive bar.

Title: 172. The Unseen
description: Three female reporters find themselves staying overnight in a house occupied by a hostile being that lurks in the basement.

Title: 173. Schizoid
description: An advice columnist in the midst of getting a divorce begins receiving threatening notes from an anonymous stalker. Meanwhile, members of her group therapy session are being murdered by an unknown assailant.

Title: 174. The Child Woman
description: Elisabeth, a 11 year old girl, visits Marcel, a mute gardener every morning with whom she shares a very particular friendship. During three years, their bond grows stronger, as Marcel seems to be the only person she can connect to.

Title: 175. Dangerous Encounters of the First Kind
description: Three teenagers run over a man while driving a car. A sadistic teenager, whose brother is a cop, sees what happened, and proceeds to blackmail them into doing her bidding, which leads to them becoming involved in something very dangerous.

Title: 176. Up the Academy
description: Four boys are sent, for different reasons, to a Military Academy. The life of discipline asks a lot of the four geeks. Of course these boys know how to make a party out of the hard times. Will they be "real men" after one year.

Title: 177. Borderline
description: On the U.S.-Mexican border, border cop Jeb Maynard is hunting for a human smuggler responsible for Jeb's partner's murder.

Title: 178. Bye Bye Brazil
description: Salomé, Lorde Cigano, and Andorinha are three traveling artists who roam the country performing shows for the poorest. The accordion player Ciço and his wife Dasdô join them as they set out on the Transamazonian Highway to reach Altamira.

Title: 179. Two Female Spies with Flowered Panties
description: Two strippers are released from prison to work undercover for the U.S. government.

Title: 180. Aunt Alejandra
description: Old aunt Alejandra goes to live with a Mexican middle-class family; she's bitter and the children tease her and make her life miserable, but the old woman is truly a witch, and takes revenge.

Title: 181. Windwalker
description: In 1797 Utah, an aged Cheyenne patriarch helps his kin to fight off a raiding party of rival Crow warriors and he tells his grandchildren the story of their family.

Title: 182. Stage Fright
description: A stage actress - who is hiding a deep trauma over the car accident that killed her mother - finds herself living a new nightmare when her fellow cast members are butchered by a glass-wielding killer.

Title: 183. Albert Pinto Ko Gussa Kyon Ata Hai
description: A man from Mumbai (then Bombay) is angry about various issues in different circumstances.

Title: 184. Scared to Death
description: A former police officer turned novelist comes out of retirement to investigate apparent serial killings, which turn out to be caused by the Syngenor - a synthesized genetic organism.

Title: 185. Girls
description: Three girls: Susanne, Annie and Catherine, just have finished high school and meet every night to have a good time in discos and bars with frequently changing boyfriends.

Title: 186. Don't Answer the Phone!
description: A deeply disturbed Vietnam veteran terrorizes the young women of Los Angeles and taunts a radio psychologist with descriptions of his grisly crimes.

Title: 187. Zübük
description: Zübük gets expelled from the political party that he is a member of, due to corruption. The journalist Yasar wants to make a news story about his case and investigates Zübük's doings. Yasar gets baffled at the sly tricks Zübük played on his village people.

Title: 188. Zigeunerweisen
description: A surreal period film following a university professor and his eerie nomad friend as they go through loose romantic triangles and face death in peculiar ways.

Title: 189. The Touch
description: Anirudh Parmar is blind, but he does not let this impairment bind him down. He runs a school for the blind as a Principal. He meets with social worker, Kavita. Kavita is attracted to him, and he slowly also gets attracted to her. When marriage is proposed, both agree to marry each other. Then Anirudh starts having doubts whether this marriage is going to succeed, as he feels he is being patronized, and pittied.

Title: 190. Qurbani
description: Two friends live happily until misunderstandings arise between them.

Title: 191. The Falls
description: 92 BBC documentary-style shorts that record the lives of 92 victims of the VUE (Violent Unexplained Event), each with last names beginning with "Fall."

Title: 192. Le Guignolo
description: Alexandre Dupré is a con artist, accidentally involved in a hunt for microfilm, containing a valuable invention of a recently murdered French scientist.

Title: 193. Aakrosh
description: A public prosecutor discovers the harsh realities about life of the scheduled tribes in India during 1980s while defending a case of a tribesman charged of murdering his wife.

Title: 194. The Garage
description: Meeting of the garage cooperative must exclude four own members because of a new highway's building. After the meeting it becomes clear that the exit door is closed by one of the members, who requires an equitable solution.

Title: 195. Heroes Shed No Tears
description: A young swordsman is given a mission by his elderly master to take a cursed sword and interfere in a deadly feud between two skilled martial arts clans vying for power.

Title: 196. V moey smerti proshu vinit Klavu K.
description: Klava and Seryozha (Sergey) have been together since preschool. He, one of the smartest kids in school, has always been in love with her but considered her more of just a pretty face rather than an intelligent person. He let her copy his homework and gave her his parents' things as gifts. When they are teens, Klava rejects his love because she knows that he doesn't value her for her, and instead is attracted to Lavrik, another intelligent boy from school. Klava likes him because for the first time she feels like someone is really interested in her as a person. Seryoszha, being very dramatic and wanting Klava's/everyone else's sympathy, writes a suicide note, "Please blame Klava K. for my death," but can he really commit suicide? Eventually he realizes that he is being too shallow and that while he makes such a drama out of such small problems, the people around him have real problems, but never said a thing.

Title: 197. Eaten Alive!
description: A determined woman enters the New Guinea jungle with an American guide to find her missing sister, only to discover a secretive sect trapped between fanaticism and cannibal tribes.

Title: 198. Forbidden Zone
description: The bizarre and musical tale of a woman who travels to another dimension through the gateway found in her family's basement.

Title: 199. Car-Napping - Bestellt, geklaut, geliefert
description: An ordinary law-abiding man finds himself in straitened circumstances, and decides to pass himself off as a Baron, adopting the life-style of the rich. He is very successful at dealing in stolen luxury cars.

Title: 200. Spetters
description: Several Dutch teenagers realize the cruel difference between dreams and reality.

Title: 201. Hell of the Living Dead
description: After an experiment gone wrong, a virus that turns people into zombies spreads throughout New Guinea. A female reporter and her cameraman, and a team of four commandos sent to investigate try to survive the onslaught.

Title: 202. Goodbye Dear Mom
description: Daniel, the son of an important businessman, discovers an intense incestuous desire for his mother after a car accident in which his father dies.

Title: 203. The Club
description: Boardroom and dressing-room intrigues spill on to the field at the Australian Rules football club.

Title: 204. The Mountain Men
description: A pair of grizzled frontiersmen fight Indians, guzzle liquor and steal squaws in their search for a legendary valley 'so full of beaver that they jump right into your traps' in this fanciful adventure.

Title: 205. The Rascals
description: In occupied France during WWII, Catholic students Didier and Bernard go on a date with Marie-Helene, an older girl Didier has no interest in, but Bernard falls for.

Title: 206. The Grim Reaper
description: A group of friends and a hitchhiker become stranded on a tourist island where they are stalked by a disfigured cannibalistic killer who is prowling the island after killing its residents.

Title: 207. Zombie Holocaust
description: Members of an expedition in the East Indies encounter not only the cannibals they were looking for, but also an evil scientist and his zombie army.

Title: 208. The Private Eyes
description: Scotland Yard sends a goofy pair to check on foul play at a mansion outside 1920s London.

Title: 209. The Exterminator
description: A man's best friend is killed on the streets of New York City. The man (Robert Ginty) then transforms into a violent killer, turning New York City into a great war zone, and Christopher George is the only one to stop him.

Title: 210. Macabre
description: An adulterous woman traumatized by the deaths of both her son and lover moves into a New Orleans boarding house, where the blind landlord suspects that she is somehow continuing her affair.

Title: 211. Night of the Demon
description: An anthropologist and his students attempt to track down a Bigfoot responsible for a rash of violent murders, only to uncover something even more sinister.

Title: 212. The Hearse
description: A schoolteacher moves into her deceased aunt's home in a small town, only to find herself plagued by supernatural occurrences and unexplained hostility from the local townspeople connected to her aunt's past.

Title: 213. The Seven Kittens
description: Noronha, a low-class civil servant and his wife Gorda have four elder daughters. Silene, the youngest, is expelled from boarding school for killing a cat and newborns.

Title: 214. Mother's Day
description: Two brothers kidnap and brutalize three women for the pleasure of their demented mother.

Title: 215. Funeral Home
description: A young woman arrives at her grandmother's house, which used to be a funeral home, to help her turn the place into a bed-and-breakfast inn. After they open, guests begin disappearing or turning up dead.

Title: 216. Contamination
description: A former astronaut helps a government agent and a police detective track the source of mysterious alien pod spores, filled with lethal flesh-dissolving acid, to a South American coffee plantation controlled by alien pod clones.

Title: 217. Virus
description: After a virus devastates the global human population, survivors in Antarctica desperately try to find a cure and save the human race.

Title: 218. The Garden of Eden
description: A young pickpocket meets a sheltered teenage girl at an art museum while trying to lift her wallet. He falls in love with her and lures her to deserted strip of beach where he pretends his motorbike has broken. An unlikely romance follows.

Title: 219. Super Fuzz
description: Red powder from a nuclear explosion gives a police officer super powers as long as he doesn't see anything red. He is eventually framed for murder and is unsuccessfully executed by many different methods.

Title: 220. Desideria
description: All her life, the fat, homely child had been ignored by her rich, and gorgeous mother. Tensions explode when the daughter catches her mother in bed with her lover and the maid.

Title: 221. Hawk the Slayer
description: With the aid of his companions, a man seeks to defeat his evil brother who has taken a nun hostage.

Title: 222. Cannibal Apocalypse
description: A pair of Vietnam War POWs return to America carrying a dangerous virus that turns people cannibalistic when bitten, and their cravings spiral into havoc that sweeps the city of Atlanta.

Title: 223. Bare Behind Bars
description: In a prison, women rebel against the guards' sadism and sexual abuse and decide to run away. Some manage to escape and are chased by the Police.

Title: 224. Secrets of a French Maid
description: Frau Oberst has 2 young nieces who are very open with their sexuality. She hopes to find adequate lovers for her nieces and along the way finds herself in some precarious sexual situations.

Title: 225. Can't Stop the Music
description: A DJ and composer from New York seeks to form an innovative musical group. With the help of a former model and a lawyer, they recruit six singers from the Greenwich Village for a disco adventure full of fantasy and fun in the 80s.

Title: 226. The Boogey Man
description: Through the reflection in the mirror, a girl witnesses her mother's boyfriend's murder.

Title: 227. Caged Women
description: Delinquent women are shipped to an island prison run by the sadistic warden Carla. Forced into situations of sexual perversion and violence and torture, the prisoners band together to try to overthrow Carla and escape the island.

Title: 228. The Children
description: A nuclear-plant leak turns a bus-load of children into murderous atomic zombies with black fingernails.

Title: 229. Devil Hunter
description: a young woman modelling in South America is kidnapped for ransom in the jungle when a Vietnam veteran is going to rescue her only to find out that the jungle is filled with cannibals

Title: 230. Giselle
description: Giselle seduces all the members of her family. She indirectly causes the failure of her father's marriage, for her stepmother falls in love with her. Then, she has affairs with her father's stepson, and with the farm housekeeper.

Title: 231. A Change of Seasons
description: Middle-aged self-centered university lecturer Adam Evans falls for sexy young student Lindsey Rutledge. Things grow complicated when Adam's wife Karyn finds out and retaliates by starting a hot affair with carpenter Pete LaChapelle.

Title: 232. Lulu
description: The story of a sexually-enticing young dancer who rises in society through her relationships with wealthy men, but later falls into poverty and prostitution, culminating in an encounter with Jack "the Ripper."

Title: 233. Escape from Hell
description: Abused female prisoners at an all-women's prison camp in the tropics plot revenge against their sadistic overseers.

Title: 234. White Cannibal Queen
description: A man who lost an arm and his family to a tribe of cannibals returns ten years later to bring back his teenager daughter, only to find that she grew up into a beautiful blonde woman who became the cannibals' queen.

Title: 235. Blood Beach
description: Something is attacking and killing people on the beach. David and Mariana, old friends, search for clues where they played as kids to uncover the mysterious creature.

Title: 236. Who's Singin' Over There?
description: It's April 5, 1941, somewhere in Serbia. A group of people go on a bus to Belgrade, on a journey that will change their lives forever.

Title: 237. Unos granujas decentes
description: A sympatic nun arrives at a convent that is the object of the greed of some real estate speculators. But she is the one to confront them by all means she can use.

Title: 238. Le coeur à l'envers
description: Laure is a 40-year-old psychologist who doesn't know her son, Jean. But the latter comes back to Paris and finds a brand new woman when he sees his mother.

Title: 239. Patrick Still Lives
description: Five people receive an anonymous letter revealing a secret of theirs and inviting them to come stay at a mansion that houses a clinic run by a corrupt doctor who experiments on the brain of his comatose son.

Title: 240. Ruckus
description: A Vietnam veteran passing through a small town is harassed by local bullies but he fights back, using his wartime skills, and triggers a full-scale police manhunt.

Title: 241. Tranquille Donne Di Campagna
description: Guido Maldini lives with his family in estate in the Po Valley countryside during the times of fascism. His violent temperament makes him hated by everyone and above all by his son who, seized by exasperation, tries in vain to kill him.

Title: 242. Harlequin
description: An enigmatic faith healer - who appears to possess genuine magical powers - and a political fixer vie for influence over a senator and his family.

Title: 243. The Young Master
description: Youthful martial arts master Lung is searching for his missing brother, when he is mistaken for a criminal on the run. He must prove his innocence by solving the case himself, while lawmen and mercenaries are hot on his trail.

Title: 244. Taxi to the Toilet
description: Frank Ripploh is a rascal: he is a shaggy-haired, bearded teacher who is gay and has a very active sex life plus an interest in making films. He keeps his personal life separate from his personal life, though sometimes he corrects student papers in public toilets as he waits to score. He cruises constantly. One evening, he meets Bernd and they become lovers. Bernd is attentive and caring, but Frank gets bored with him and continues his polymorphous perverse ways. How long will Bernd and Frank tolerate each other's habits, and how long can Frank keep his sexual orientation outside of the classroom? Things "come to a head" (no pun intended) during Berlin's annual Queen's Ball and the morning after.

Title: 245. Wicked Memoirs of Eugenie
description: Eugenie, daughter of a wealthy diplomat in Spain, boldly flaunts her youthful figure. An illicit father-daughter relationship with disturbing undertones unfolds amidst the coastal setting and nightlife.

Title: 246. The True Story of the Nun of Monza
description: Sister Virginia becomes the new Mother Superior at the convent of Monza. Debauched priest Don Arrigone and lecherous womanizer Giampaolo Osio plot to seduce sister Virginia by any means necessary.

Title: 247. Schoolgirl Report Vol. 13: Don't Forget Love During Sex
description: During rehearsals for a school performance, a group of students discusses whether sex and love belong together, and whether both together in a relationship is possible.

Title: 248. Los últimos golpes de 'El Torete'
description: El Torete and El Vaquilla are two juvenile delinquents with numerous criminal records that coincide in the robbery of the same bank, deciding to be companions thereafter.

Title: 249. Christmas Evil
description: A toy factory worker, mentally scarred as a child upon learning Santa Claus is not real, suffers a nervous breakdown after being belittled at work, and embarks on a Yuletide killing spree.

Title: 250. Alien 2: On Earth
description: Astronauts become monstrous host-inhabiting creatures after space mission. Cave explorers encounter these beings underground. Survivors try escaping and fighting the threat.

Title: 251. High Test Girls
description: Six women inherit a gas station and have sex with the customers while their cars are getting filled up outside.

Title: 252. New Year's Evil
description: During New Year's celebrations, a killer calls a disc jockey as he murders one reveler at midnight in each time zone.

Title: 253. The Earthling
description: Diagnosed with a terminal form of cancer, Patrick Foley has returned to his native Australia to die in the peace and quiet of the wilderness. His simple plan is complicated, however, when he meets a young boy who has just lost his parents.

Title: 254. Hussy
description: A theater tech falls in love with a prostitute who works at his club. Their relationship faces threats from her violent ex, her son's father, and his dubious friend who proposes a get-rich scheme.

Title: 255. Permanent Vacation
description: A young man wanders New York City searching for some meaning in life and encounters many idiosyncratic characters.

Title: 256. Milka: Elokuva tabuista
description: In Finnish Lapland, 14-year-old Milka and her mother hire a field hand who becomes romantically involved with both. He impregnates Milka before leaving them.

Title: 257. Shaan
description: Two brothers go after the international mafia kingpin who murdered their cop brother. They are later joined by another man who wants revenge against the gangster.

Title: 258. Estigma
description: Sebastian's death wishes seem to cause horrible accidents which he is unable to control. When his older brother dies, he blames himself. His apparent supernatural powers continue, and he becomes even more violent and sadistic.

Title: 259. Golem
description: In a tech-controlled future world, monsters have become the dominant species. When one of them falls under suspicion of being human, the classic Golem tale gets a unique sci-fi twist.

Title: 260. The Charter Trip
description: Despite a harrowing fear of flying Stig-Helmer decides to go to the Canary Islands. On the plane, he meets the boasting Norwegian Ole and a load of Swedes on their way to holiday where they will meet a lot of difficulties and situations.

Title: 261. Vicious and Nude
description: An aging writer, Juan (Jack Taylor) has a successful career and a nice family. One day, the family goes on a trip and he stays at home. Two beautiful girls knock on his door and claim their car broke down. He lets them in and gets seduced. Deadly mistake.

Title: 262. D.O.A.
description: Documentary chronicaling the rise and fall of the punk movement with rare interview footage of Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen. Also concert and news footage.

Title: 263. Terror Express
description: Three thugs commandeer a few cars on a moving train and spread terror among the passengers.

Title: 264. Hex
description: A sickly young woman and her new maid kill her abusive husband, only to see him return as a vengeful ghost, but nothing is as it seems.

Title: 265. Obsession
description: The story of the impossible love between a schoolgirl and a sixty-year-old painter.

Title: 266. Nightkill
description: A woman's lover poisons her cruel husband, a rich businessman, in front of her. She becomes more terrified when she finds the lover dead as well. A police detective suddenly shows up at her door.

Title: 268. It's My Turn
description: A successful but stressed mathematics professor goes to her father's wedding and falls in love with the son of her new stepmother.

Title: 269. Demented
description: After being gang raped and institutionalized, a woman suffers nightmares while under the care of her unfaithful husband, and finally snaps when a group of masked youths decide to invade her house.

Title: 270. Encounter of the Spooky Kind
description: A rickshaw driver's wife and his rich client are secret lovers, and they decide to get rid of him without being implicated, so they hire a powerful sorcerer to kill him, but the sorcerer's colleague intervenes to protect him.

Title: 271. Karz
description: Ravi is killed by his wife after his marriage. He is reborn as Monty and is now a singer he goes to holiday in Ooty where he recollects his memories from previous life and inquires about his family from first life and his evil wife Kamini.

Title: 272. Erotic Symphony
description: A nobleman and his two lovers - a teenage boy and a runaway nun - plan to kill his mentally fragile wife.

Title: 274. Ta gueule, je t'aime!
description: To impress erotic film actress Fanny, Marco takes her for a ride in his new racing-car, but they get into an accident.

Title: 275. The Under-Gifted
description: Notorious dunces, the students of a Bac school compete in ingenuity and cheating to obtain the coveted diploma.

Title: 276. The Return
description: In New Mexico, an alien spacecraft abducts two young children and an old man. 25 years later, the children are returned as adults to the same town now beset by strange cattle mutilations.

Title: 277. To All a Goodnight
description: Beautiful prep-school students face yuletide horror when a killer in a Santa Claus suit stalks their campus.

Title: 278. Tusk
description: An English girl and an Indian elephant born on the same day share a common destiny.

Title: 279. McVicar
description: John McVicar was a notorious London criminal known as "Public Enemy No. 1" for armed bank robberies. He was captured and imprisoned in a high security facility, but continued attempting escapes.

Title: 280. Sex Hunter
description: After a Swan Lake performance, ballerina Miki gets flowers from fans, including famous dancer Akiko who invites her to study at her prestigious academy. Miki soon learns the school isn't what it seems.

Title: 281. Solo Sunny
description: Sunny is a singer in a band which is constantly on the road. She therefore leads a relatively restless life, which she cannot afford to give up, having to rely on the fee she gets paid..

Title: 282. George and Mildred
description: Mildred decides that she and George will celebrate their anniversary at a posh London hotel - whatever the cost. However, a shady businessman mistakes George for a hit man.

Title: 283. Fists of the White Lotus
description: The Qing emperor releases all detained Shaolin disciples, but the vindictive White Lotus clan decides to exterminate all the disciples. One martial artist survives the onslaught, and constantly trains while in hiding for revenge.

Title: 284. Animalympics
description: The animal kingdom stages its own olympic games.

Title: 285. The Happy Hooker Goes Hollywood
description: A prostitute writes a bestseller book about her profession which attracts the attention of a studio executive who attempts to adapt it into a movie. They have a falling off and she decides to make the film on her own despite sabotage.

Title: 286. Return to the 36th Chamber
description: After failing to help his friends at the local dyeing mill who're getting bullied by Manchurians, a lowly street hustler sneaks into the Shaolin Temple, and is willing to do anything to learn kung fu and help his friends.

Title: 287. Night Games
description: A Californian housewife is terrified of having sex because of a past assault. When this phobia threatens to destroy her marriage, she takes refuge in a series of erotic fantasies about a masked man. But is it really all just a fantasy?

Title: 288. Cannibal Terror
description: After botching a kidnapping, two criminals hide with their victim in a friends house in the jungle. After one of them rapes the friend's wife, they're left to be eaten by a nearby cannibal tribe.

Title: 289. From the Life of the Marionettes
description: An account of the events before and after a murder committed by a disturbed businessman in a strained marriage, and what led him to perform such a shocking act.

Title: 290. Bello di mamma
description: Domenico, known as Mimì, must prove to his parents that he is not impotent and homosexual, only this way will he be able to unlock himself and receive the rich family heritage.

Title: 291. Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
description: An ugly, misshapen podiatrist ingests a formula made by a colleague and turns into a handsome, devil-may-care (but violent) ladies' man.

Title: 292. Blow Job
description: A young man finds himself enticed into a strange house by a charming witch. The film puts together a dreamlike tapestry exploring decay and desire, blurring fantasy and reality.

Title: 293. Girl with the Golden Panties
description: Luis, an aging Falangist author with guilty conscious, is writing fake memoirs. Two reporters, his niece Mariana and her lesbian friend Elmyr, arrive to do a piece on him. While fact-checking his memoirs Mariana becomes attracted to him.

Title: 294. Tomorrow's Joe: The Movie
description: While serving his sentence in a Tokyo juvenile detention center, a wandering orphaned slum-dog enters the world of professional boxing after befriending an incarcerated pugilistic prodigy.

Title: 295. And Next Year at Lake Balaton
description: Set in the 1970-s, in Socialist Central Europe. An East German guy with a Dutch girl -- hitchhiking their way, with all sorts of adventures. It feels like you're on a holiday yourself.

Title: 296. Three Men to Kill
description: A man is pursued by killers after helping someone at a car crash.

Title: 297. Defiance
description: An out-of work merchant seaman single-handedly tames a powerful street gang "The Souls" that has been terrorizing his neighborhood on New York City's Lower East Side.

Title: 298. Contraband
description: Someone is muscling in on the two brothers' cigarette smuggling into Italy at Naples. The police is tipped off, then Mickey's stable burns down, then the killing etc. starts. Luca responds.

Title: 299. Tanya's Island
description: Tanya and her beau escape to the solitude of a tropical island. When a hulking gorilla sets his sights, and paws, on the lovely Tanya's attention, a bizarre battle for the woman's love ensues between the three desperate island dwellers.

Title: 300. Habfürdö
description: On his wedding day, eccentric 40-something shop decorator Zsolt Mohai visits Anna Parádi, asking her to call off his marriage to Klára Horváth. Drama and musical numbers follow as they discuss romance, loyalty, ambition.

Title: 301. The Great Rock 'n' Roll Swindle
description: Filmmaker Julien Temple chronicles the Sex Pistols' tumultuous rise to fame, as told by their manager, Malcolm McLaren.

Title: 302. My American Uncle
description: The intersecting stories of three people who face difficult choices in life-changing situations are used to illustrate the theories espoused by Henri Laborit about human behavior and the relationship between the self and society.

Title: 303. Zoom In: Sex Apartments
description: Saeko, a somewhat enigmatic young woman, is brutally beaten with a rock and raped by a man wearing a dark-colored mask and black gloves. She eventually recovers, but not long afterwards a series of horrific murders begins occurring in the apartment building she lives in. When it turns out that the victims are badly beaten, then killed and their genitals burned off, Saeko begins to think she has an idea who the killer is, but realizes she may be murdered before she has a chance to expose the maniac.

Title: 304. Rising Damp
description: Landlord Rigsby scams lodgers Cooper and Philip into sharing a room. His favorite tenant, Miss Jones, flirts with Philip, annoying Rigsby. When new lodger Seymour arrives, Miss Jones falls for him, leaving Rigsby's love for her unrequited.

Title: 305. Challenge of the Tiger
description: Two CIA agents - a kung fu master and a suave womanizer - track the stolen formula for a super-sterility drug from Spain to Hong Kong, battling Neo-Nazi terrorists and a Vietnamese spy ring for its possession.

Title: 306. Forbidden Passion
description: Teresa, a cabaret dancer, has to leave her job due to her father's death. She decides to go to the small town where her brother Miguel lives. Teresa begins to feel attracted to Miguel and tries to seduce him.

Title: 307. A Sweet Journey
description: Childhood friends, dominant Helene and submissive Lucie, are now in their thirties and married. Nostalgic about their youth, they take a bonding car trip to French countryside, while discussing their real and made up sexual experiences.

Title: 308. La ragazza di Via Millelire
description: Betty is a 13-year-old immigrant trapped in a seedy neighborhood of Turin. Her options are limited: a life of prostitution, drugs and violence. While she aspires to a better life, the only option available is a social care center.

Title: 309. O Gosto do Pecado
description: Thinking that his marriage has fallen into a routine and trying to regain his freedom, Julio Garcia divorces Regina. He gives himself into orgies promoted by his friend, who is a lawyer. He also starts to seduce beautiful and naive girls.

Title: 310. Cabo Blanco
description: In 1948, an assortment of shady characters are searching for Nazi loot, sunken off the coast of Peru.

Title: 311. Game of Death II
description: After Billy Lo is killed while seeking the murderers of his friend, his brother Bobby goes all out to bring the perpetrators to justice.

Title: 312. Goodbye Pork Pie
description: Dumped by his girlfriend, a man joins a reckless youth in a stolen yellow mini and they drive the length of New Zealand, attracting cops and media attention, determined to get to Invercargill.

Title: 313. Island Claws
description: A biological experiment in Florida goes awry. The result: 8-foot long land crabs which roar loudly and kill everything in sight.

Title: 314. La zia di Monica
description: A supernatural bond connects two women through life and beyond, intertwining their fates in unexpected ways as they face a haunting destiny together.

Title: 315. The Wildcats of St. Trinian's
description: The girls of St. Trinian's decide they are being asked to do too much work so they go on strike.

Title: 316. Action
description: Bruno is an idealistic hero who questions the meaning of life in this confusing and sometimes hallucinatory erotic drama. After a night in jail, he is gang-raped by punk rockers in a garbage dump. He later saves an old man who believes he is Garibaldi and a woman he believes is Ophelia. Bruno watches helplessly as she later jumps from a window.

Title: 317. Gorp
description: A slapstick comedy about the wacky antics of a group of waiters at a Jewish summer camp in upstate New York.

Title: 318. Beyond Evil
description: An architect and his wife move into a colonial mansion, where the demonic presence of the original owner's wife takes residence.

Title: 319. The Amorous Sisters
description: Comedy about some schoolgirls being taught anatomy (of the sexual nature) by the sexually frustrated Barbara Moose. Part 1 of "Deutschland privat" gives us typical German home movies of the 1970s, i.e. private holidays, family parties, etc. Part 2 consists of what is now called "amateur porn"; home made 8mm movies featuring real porn action.

Title: 458. Yo hice a Roque III
description: Federico provides accommodation in his house for his friend Roque who is unemployed and becomes annoying. To get rid of him, Fernando tries to make Roque a boxing champion who will be able to challenge the current national boxing champion.

Title: 459. Aasha
description: Deepak (Jeetendra) is a truck driver. One day he meets with haughty, snobbish, and popular singer, Asha. He assists her with her travel and the two become friends. Deepak loves Mala, introduces her to him mom, and soon they are married. Mala has eye problems, and eventually loses her sight. While travelling, Deepak has an accident and his body is nowhere to be found. Deepak's mom blames a pregnant Mala for this bad luck, and throws her out of the house. Mala gives birth to a baby girl, and both live a very poor and destitute life. Deepak has met with Asha several times, and would like to marry her. Asha would also like to marry Deepak. And then Asha finds out that Mala is still alive, and she must now decide to withhold that information from Deepak so she could marry him instead or tell him the truth and lose him forever.

Title: 460. Treasures of the Snow
description: 13-year-old Lucien is traumatized and ostracized by causing his friend Danny to fall off a cliff. As he finds solitude in the nearby woods, Lucien comes across a woodcarver who helps him find the peace he was looking for.

Title: 461. Thodisi Bewafaii
description: Arun takes on the responsibility for the care of his step-mother (Sujatha) and step-sisters on the death of his father. Losses in business result in the sale of their palatial home, and Arun together with his wife (Neema - Shabana Azmi) move to a smaller house. Tensions escalate between Neema and Sujatha, even as Arun struggles financially to meet the needs of his family. Things come to a head when she sees her husband eating sweets from the hand of a beautiful woman doctor in a restaurant. Neema leaves her matrimonial home together with her son Abhinandan. Neema sells her jewelry to support her brother's education, without any return on her investment. She and Abhinandan live a life of genteel poverty on the charity of another brother. Divorce court judgment leaves Arun dissatisfied and resentful and he does not meet his son for years. Meanwhile, Neema feeling wronged and cheated by Arun thinks he has remarried and has a new child. The thread of the story begins to unravel when Abhinandan comes to Bombay for higher education. Does Abhinandan hate his father? Does he ride his Rajdoot-Bobby motorcycle from Bombay to Nasik? What happens when Neema and Arun come face to face, after many years in common grief, worry and concern for the well being of a loved one is to be watched.

Title: 462. The Night at the Terrace
description: Three sailors arrive in Brazil and split up in São Paulo. Their separate adventures - involving a secret letter, bar trouble, and hippie connections - spiral into transformative experiences.

Title: 463. Garlic Is as Good as Ten Mothers
description: A documentary on the history of garlic. Blank interviews chefs, garlic lovers, and historians about the their love of the 'stinking rose.'

Title: 464. Running Scared
description: It's 1961. Two servicemen smuggle a box of military gear to USA. Leroy tries out a military camera and accidentally takes a picture of some military facilities. Army finds one of the pictures and thinks they're communist spies.

Title: 465. On Fertile Lands
description: The tragic story of three farm worker who migrates from their village to the cotton land Çukurova.

Title: 466. Bona
description: A female movie fan idolizes a movie bit-player who becomes her obsession. Her unrequited love for him leads to a nightmarish end.

Title: 467. La banquière
description: Emma Eckhert, from a modest background, became a big sensation between 1914 and 1938 as a banker and the head of a financial paper specialized in public savings.

Title: 468. Crazy Thunder Road
description: When Ken, the leader of a once-notorious Tokyo biker gang, falls in love with a barmaid, he quickly loses his rebellious ideals. The rest of the gang feels betrayed, especially the troubled kid Jin, who revolts against his former friend.

Title: 469. Bloodrage
description: A sexually frustrated young man kills hookers.

Title: 470. Death Games
description: A reporter and his girlfriend follow around a famous actor/entrepreneur and discover some dirt on him to be made public.

Title: 471. Haunted Tales
description: A horror anthology of two parts: a newlywed woman is plagued by ghosts after moving with her husband into their new house, and a drunkard building supervisor wins the lottery thanks to a haunted Ouija board, but matters begin to go awry.

Title: 472. The Bloody Lady
description: The folktale about Bloody Lady Bathory, doomed to bathe in the blood of young girls in order to be forever youthful herself

Title: 473. College Girl on Vacation
description: Massimo has a young mistress and, for seeing her even when the family moves to their beach house, she will come at the house dressed as a nun and with the purpose of tutoring Massimo's daughter, who failed at school.

Title: 474. Superman
description: An orphaned boy is granted superpowers after praying to the god Hanuman.

Title: 475. Captive
description: Two survivors of an alien spaceship crash-land on earth and hold two people hostage.

Title: 477. Cloud Dancer
description: As a world champion aerobatics pilot Brad Randolph is accustomed to pushing his plane to the limit to achieve masterful aeronautics. Now in his early 40s, life throws a set of new challenges Brad's way that test his mettle.

Title: 478. Abdullah
description: Abdullah is a devout Muslim who lives in a small hut the middle of a desert in Persia, and looks after a well so that it provides water to thirsty travelers. One day a friend, Ameer, informs him that bandit Khaleel had raided a settlement nearby, killing everyone except for Yashoda, a pregnant woman. Shortly thereafter, Ameer himself is killed, a mortally wounded Yashoda gives birth to a boy, names him Krishna, asks Abdullah to care for him, and passes away. Abdullah overcomes his fears of bringing up a Hindu boy, and looks after Krishna as his own. Then Khaleel's Magician informs him that he is going to die at the hands of Krishna, just as Bhagwan Shri Krishna was known to have slain Kans, his maternal uncle, so also will Khaleel's life end at this Krishna's hands. Angered at this, Khaleel sets out to kill Krishna. He attacks Abdullah, abducts Krishna and readies him for a sacrifice, that will get rid of any threat against him. Will fate intervene to save Krishna, or will Khaleel succeed in sacrificing him?

Title: 479. The Clones of Bruce Lee
description: A brilliant professor gathers cells from the late Bruce Lee and creates three clones, who are trained in martial arts and sent out to fight crime.

Title: 480. The Beasts
description: A father seeks revenge from a gang of thugs who raped his daughter and murdered his son.

Title: 481. Delitto a Porta Romana
description: A police inspector is called to Milan to investigate a murder case since he grew up in the same ghetto as the suspect.

Title: 483. Kaladkarin
description: AN INNOCENT BARRIO LASS GOES TO THE CITY AND ACQUIRES MATERIAL WEALTH AND WORDLY KNOWLEDGE.

Title: 484. Friend
description: Rudy, an ex-boxer who works as a film stuntman, is a kindhearted young man who dedicates his life to caring for a young orphan Poncho, until he leaves him at an orphanage that educates homeless children. Poncho feels betrayed.

Title: 485. I Hate Blondes
description: There are two problems with Emilio and his career as a pulp writer. Emilio is a bumbling fellow who has absolutely nothing in common with the heroes he writes about. Second, Emilio can't seem to publish anything under his own name.

Title: 486. The Pilot
description: Mike Hagan is a pilot in passenger service and candidate for the honor "Best Pilot of the Year". Nobody knows that he's got private sorrows - he's an alcoholic. A stewardess notices his regular visits of the toilet and reports it.

Title: 487. Der Kurpfuscher und seine fixen Töchter
description: A smooth-talking rogue assumes the identity of the new village doctor, and soon has a thriving practice with the help of three quick-witted "daughters".

Title: 488. Germany Pale Mother
description: Germany 1939. Hans and Lene marry the day before the war breaks out, and Hans is sent to the Eastern front. During a bombing raid their daughter Anna is born. The house is destroyed and Lene and Anna moves in with relatives in Berlin. Hans survives the war but he is not the same person as in 1939, and he and Lene find it difficult to live together again.

Title: 489. A Man Called Intrepid
description: The wealthy Canadian Sir William Stephenson uses his own money to help the Allies form an espionage network doing the work behind war actions, like the Heavy Water Sabotage and getting hold of the Enigma code machine.

Title: 490. Io e Caterina
description:
Enrico Melotti, a middle-aged businessman, is dominated by a fierce as naive form of machismo and sees women only for what they can give him, both in terms of emotional and sexual satisfaction, and in terms of labor services and domestic labor. Therefore, he has a difficult relationship with his wife Marisa, his secretary/lover Claudia and his maid Teresa.

During a business trip to America, his friend Arturo shows him how he solved the same problems. At Arturo's home, Enrico is astonished in seeing Caterina, a female-looking robotic maid that does all domestic chores better than a human because it doesn't need to sleep or feed. The only thing that puzzles Enrico is that the robot keeps calling Arturo by phone at regular intervals, as if to show concern like a human mate.

Returning home from the trip, Enrico has again arguments with Claudia, Teresa and Marisa: he ignores Claudia's complaints (she would have him leave his wife and be with her in the public), he disapproves of Marisa having a job and a social life, and demands that Teresa perform extra activities on her evening off.

Enrico resolves to break the relationship with the three women and to buy a Caterina robot for domestic duties, determined to live alone and not having to answer to anyone. At first, although spending is significant, everything seems to be going well, although Catherine shows strange (almost human) reactions and gives some strange sign of unrest during a visit from Marisa.

Enrico believes that he has solved all of his problems, and starts looking for a female companion that does not demand so much as his former ones. He invites home the young and beautiful Elisabetta, whom he met at Marisa's store. The girl becomes uneasy at the sight of Caterina (as Enrico's ex-wife had been), especially after the robot seems to reject her as it did with Marisa.

When Enrico and Elisabetta are about to spend the night together, Caterina loses control, plays havoc with the house and even tries to kill its master. Elisabetta panics, runs away and disappears from Enrico's life.

The intervention of the engineer who built the robot is of little help: Caterina, in fact, is such a sophisticated machine that it acquired almost total autonomy from its original setting. In front of the engineer it pretends to behave, in order not to be removed and replaced, but as soon as the technician goes away, she starts imposing conditions on Enrico: she will serve him devoutly and without complaining if he will give her the respect and dedication owed to a real woman.
