description: A man travels with his pill-popping girlfriend to the headquarters of her Yakuza boss husband, in order to claim her for himself.

Title: 797. Hito Hata: Raise the Banner
description: The film looks back at the life of a man named Oda and other Japanese Americans through the decades as they face great challenges and joys living in the United States.

Title: 798. Fabel
description: A young woman hits a dog with her car, and escape the accident in pure panic into a art shop. The game is on.

Title: 799. Hilario Cortes, el rey del talón
description: A man pretends to be a woman and enters women's prison. There he is discovered by his fellow inmates but instead of revealing that he is a man, they decide to have fun with him. He enjoys his turns with different inmates until the authorities find out his true identity. He is then transferred to a prison for men.

Title: 800. Oru Kai Osai
description: A man loses his voice after his mother's shocking death. Later, he falls in love with a doctor who comes to practise in his village. Will he be able to regain his voice with her help?

Title: 801. Les contes de La Fontaine
description: Four tales of Jean la Fontaine tell in a libertine way. The pleasure of infidelity is described in all forms: a woman seduced by her servant, a man seduce his servant, the wives of Messire Guillaume, and a bourgeois and a nun.

Title: 802. Úteky domu
description: The three main characters are Michal, an airplane mechanic, Marie, a fashion designer, and ten-year-old Honzík, who form a seemingly happy, well-adjusted family. Michal goes out with his son to fly aeronautical models, while his mother works on her designs and they spend weekends together at the cottage by the pond. However, the first moments of unrest, caused mainly by the workload of the ambitious Marie, start to creep into the peaceful relationship. She is currently preparing the costumes for a stage play. It is her first job for the theatre and since she wants to make a name for herself in this field, the result is important to her. She finds it hard to bear that her designs have not been received with enthusiasm, and she is slowly starting to get into a time crunch.

Title: 803. Belønningen
description: A company director and a tramp bump into each other, resulting in a broken liquor bottle, and a fight starts, then the police get involved. The men are former co-workers going down different roads during World War II and wind up in court.

Title: 804. Kojak Budapesten
description: Lieutenant Kojak arrives in Hungary as an invited guest at a criminology conference held in Budapest. In truth, however, he is simply coming home, as he once served there as an anonymous Hungarian patrol officer. Because of his current fame, he tries to avoid the spotlight, but he offers to take on a murder case as a favor to his former boss. As a seasoned detective, he successfully solves the case - and, along the way, captures the mafia henchmen who had been hunting him, pretending romantic interest in order to get close to him.

Title: 805. Dui Prithibi
description: Mrinal Dutta, the elder son of the family, is a reporter and the sole earning member. He has a sister whose marriage is almost fixed with their music teacher. The climax starts building up when brother Kunal Dutta returns a rich businessman. He spends money lavishly and becomes the most powerful person in the family with a house and a car. The sister's marriage is suddenly called off and a new alliance is sought after with the principal of a music school. The monetary differences between the two brothers start stemming up in various forms. Kunal unexpectedly marries a girl whose father was a freedom fighter. Kunal, however is very rude to his wife and one day she finds some evidence of Kunal being involved in smuggling. Kunal is eventually proved a smuggler. This leads to more problems in the family and sibling relationships are on doldrums. The sister's fiance takes advantage of her and impregnates her. During this time the police chase Kunal who comes begging for help from his brother. The police however arrest him and put him behind bars. After that the family pleads guilty. Kunal is punished for a term of 4 years. The sister's fiance takes responsibility of his insensitive act and all is fine with the family after a brief period of turmoil.

Title: 806. Blue Suede Shoes
description: This documentary shows the revival of British rock n' roll as it follows a weekend pilgrimage of Teddy Boys, Rockabilly Rebels and Rockers. Bands performing include Bill Haley and the Comets, Crazy Cavan & the Rhythm Rockers, Matchbox, Flying Saucers, Freddie Fingers Lee, Ray Campi and his Rockabilly Rebels.

Title: 807. Microphone Test
description: A television reporter and her cameraman find themselves in the middle of intertwined professional and personal dilemma.

Title: 808. Man Pasand
description: Kamli belongs to a poor family. She sells datuns for a living. She sells them in local suburban trains as well as on railway platforms. One day she meets a bachelor named Pratap, who would like her to become a lady, and be educated, to which she agrees. She thinks that Pratap is in love with her, little does she know that she is the subject of a bet between Pratap and his friend, Kashinath, who both find her crude, crass, loud, and uncouth, so much so that both doubt that she can be transformed into a lady.

Title: 810. Katorse
description: Too much too soon--a child--a woman at 13--and a mother at 14.

Title: 812. Shi mei chu ma
description: An abused woman's journey from near death to kung fu expert, helped by a merciful Abbess and a crippled orphan.

Title: 814. Doslo doba da se ljubav proba
description: Mary's problem was solved another state without health consequences. Now Mary is strictly controlled by the parents but still finishing high school. Bob and Mary continue their love, but there is a conflict in their families, Zika and Dara, Coils parents for the wedding ending romantic relationships of their children, and Milan and Helen, Mary's mother and father to break the connection.

Title: 815. The Long Island Cannibal Massacre
description: A series of horrible murders prompts a massive police investigation. Inspector James Cameron, a two-fisted roughneck with his own philosophy on handling crime, heads the investigation. A group of lepers living in the Long Island wastelands have created a terror network, killing and feeding off the flesh of innocent victims. Their leader has mutated into an invulnerable monster; he intends to propagate and strengthen his stronghold. Aided by his son, Jack, and a couple of motorcycle freaks, food is supplied to the clan via murder. As the authorities close in on the cannibal killers, an all-out bloodbath ensues.

Title: 816. Aguila
description: Flashbacks encompass the history of the Philippines as well as the life story of the elderly Daniel Aguila. The Aguila family gathers to celebrate Daniel's 88th birthday, but the old man is nowhere to be seen--he has been missing for a decade. Suspecting that his father is in Mindanao, one of his sons takes off for that region in a determined search. Along the way, his memories of the nation and his father's life tell the story of 80 tumultuous years of personal and historical development.

Title: 817. The Young Quebecers
description: Nicole, a coed and three of her friends invites four male university students over for a weekend of love.

Title: 818. Haine
description: A drifter on a motorcycle happens to be passing through a town immediately after a young school girl has been run over and killed by an unknown person on a motorcycle.

Title: 819. Savage Hunt
description: An American photographer unwittingly brings footage of torture by the Greek military junta into the USA along with proof of America's involvement in it.

Title: 822. Ktor me yerkinq
description: About the love of shy and honest Torik with Anjel - girl with the oldest occupation in the world. Could Torik survive the disgrace from the town?

Title: 823. Nani Maa
description: A king looking for the map of a hidden treasure finds it in the back of a framed picture in grandmothers' home. Realizing that some unscrupulous people are also in search of the map, he tears it into two, giving one to her for safekeeping. She hides it in her old gramophone box, unaware that a dacoit is watching her. She gets kidnapped and her grandsons try to find her even as the king's wicked cousin hires a magician to find the location of the map. Will grandmother be rescued and does the treasure fall in the wrong hands? This magical ride through a wondrous land won multiple awards at the Moscow Film Festival, 1981.

Title: 824. Noble Lady of Roses
description: A haunting tale set in wartime Japan follows an aristocratic woman trapped between desire and duty as she navigates a nightmarish world of passion, betrayal, and psychological torment in 1941.

Title: 825. Lambhardarni
description: The story revolves around two friends, one good and the other evil, who cannot be seperated by anyone. That is until the wrongdoing Sohan Lal rapes the wife of his friend Dhaymaya's servant.

Title: 826. Hansa Vilak
description: A married man (Nissanka) and woman (Miranda) find their lives disrupted after their affair is exposed by the police. Leaving their respective families, the two decide to live together. Shortly afterwards, Miranda secretly goes back to see her former husband. As paranoia mounts, Nissanka disintegrates psychologically to point where reality and fantasy are blurred.

Title: 827. Kamen Rider (Skyrider): Eight Riders vs. Galaxy King
description: The movie begins in space, on a space station. A space team called, TENKA, was testing a super-powered weapon on a deserted planet. It worked, so they celebrated. But Galaxy King saw this, and decides to attack the space station.

Title: 828. El charro del misterio
description: A man who loses in a poker game kills the winner's children and employees, but a Mexican horseman avenges the deaths one by one.

Title: 829. Be Forever Yamato
description: Earth has been attacked by the Black Nebula Empire and is threatening to blow up the planet if they are counterattacked, The Yamato crew try to defuse the bomb.

Title: 830. The Ring of Death
description: A tale of an underdog mistreated by his family, given kung fu instruction from an unlikely source, and redeemed when he comes back to take on foreign champions in a tournament staged before an imperial audience.

Title: 832. Bez milosci
description: Ewa is so desperate to become a well-known journalist that she can sacrifice anything and anyone to achieve her goal.

Title: 833. Blood Bride
description: A beautiful and charming betrothed is promised to a beautiful woman. But he is a completely insane killer and she will be his next victim. Everything that follows the wedding will be a carnival of wickedness, sadism and brutality.

Title: 834. The Enigmatic Case
description: An imprisoned swordsman is accused of killing three men. He probably would have already been executed for his crimes but is kept alive because he knows the whereabouts of hidden gold.

Title: 835. La dinastía de Dracula
description: In the 16th century, the Inquisition condemns Count Orloff, a vampire and sorcerer to death. In the 19th century, the vampire Madame Kostoff arrives in Mexico and buys the house where the vampire was buried and revives him.

Title: 836. Poniro thilyko... katergara gynaika!
description: Stuck in an unhappy marriage, a famous theatre star summons up the courage to seek happiness and love anew, in the shape of a young lawyer. But, is it love at first sight? Will her decision lead to an ignominious end in the show business?

Title: 837. Hellegat
description: Sam starts his first week as a helper at a brickyard. He got this job because his new boss is the chairman of the local football team for which he plays. He's a talented goalkeeper. There is much resemblance between Sam and Louis, a 65-year-old who is pottering through the last days before his retirement. They both react strongly to the illegal dumping practices of a firm from the city. But also their boss' hands do not seem to be entirely clean in this business. Will Sam sink into the rut and routine that Louis is rebelling against?

Title: 838. Punk and Its Aftershocks
description: This sequel to PUNK IN LONDON charts the rise and fall of Punk into Ska, New Wave and the Mod scene. See Britain's explosive music scene in the late 70's via live performances and exclusive interviews.

Title: 839. Jal Mahal
description: Ravi (Jeetendra) overhears a beautiful woman, Namrita (Rekha), singing a sad song. He falls in love, and tries to pull her away from the abyss of suicide. As time goes by, he proposes and introduces her to his family, only to find out that she is already married to Rajesh. He leaves home destroyed, attempting to understand life after she completes suicide...only to run into her at an ashram, where she claims she is not the same person, but a look-alike.

Title: 840. ¿A que le tiras cuando sueñas... Mexicano?
841. Sådan er jeg osse
description: Stine is eighteen and has finished school. Her parents have been divorced, and her father lives with a new wife now. Stine is hesitant in finding a regular job, as she would like to become an actress.

Title: 842. Slow Attack
description: Nik, a released prisoner who started writing in prison, wants to leave his past behind, but refuses to contact his former girlfriend and her family. Under the name of his jail buddy Henry, he moves in with his pen pal--who has never seen him--and is always watched suspiciously by their roommate. Nik seeks contact with the literary culture, although he feels disgusted by the pompous fuss of this society. He is not without talent and works on a novel in which he minutely describes the abduction of an industrialist. Henry gets shot at the prison breakout and visits Nik to get help from him. He likes his novel plot and wants to put it into action.

Title: 843. Dracula's Last Rites
description: Low budget horror film has a conspiracy of vampires in a small town (made up of the local sheriff, mortician, town doctor, and ambulance driver) creating accidents of some sort so they can operate their blood drinking dinner parties unnoticed.

Title: 844. Cute Girl
description: The daughter of a wealthy man takes French lessons so she can go to France with her fiancé, but ends up falling for a poor man who studies civil engineering.

Title: 845. Guns
description: Freelance journalist and former radical Tony blithely picks away at a gun-running plot that implicates the French government, Emirati oil barons, and a shady corporate gangster and his anxious, floundering son.

Title: 846. Prestami tua moglie
description: Alex is meeting his soon to be ex-wife Ingrid, and wants to give the impression that he is still down on his luck instead of living in a penthouse with Diane. Therefore he gets his downstairs neighbor Vittorio to lend him his messy studio. Unfortunately, Vittorio's wife Marilù is passed out drunk in the bedroom as Ingrid and Alex find themselves still attracted to one another. Also a shady businessman arrives on the scene to make a deal with Alex and is send to the wrong apartment.

Title: 847. Rendez-moi ma peau...
description: A man and a woman get into a car accident with a witch, who takes out her anger on them by switching their bodies. The whole movie deals with their predicament.

Title: 848. The Naxalites
description: A dramatized account of the Naxalite movement, focusing on the average Indians who join the movement from various walks of life and from various regions, backgrounds, faiths, etc.

Title: 849. Shiki Natsuko
description: A young woman, unhappy in her relationship, poses nude for a photographer and begins dating an actor who helps her land an acting role, hoping these changes will improve her life.

Title: 850. Bárbara
description: Barbara is an italian super star that comes to Argentina to star in her own musical, here she meets mauro, an argentinian photographer, and falls in love with him, but mauro has a secret that she will discover

Title: 851. Skateboard Madness
description: When a reporter too laid-back for his own good is told his last chance to keep his job is to get some good photos for a story on skateboarding, he seeks out a group of four boarders who agree to take him on a skateboarding tour of California. After showing extensive footage of skateboarding moves and tricks, the film then goes on to show some surfing and snowboarding. The film is also bookended by a pair of animated shorts, both about skateboard racing.

Title: 852. Uomini e no
description: In Milan, in the winter of 1944, the ruthless Cane Nero leads the Fascists against the partisans. Enne 2, one of the leading figures of the C.N.L., meets Berta, whom he loved three years ago, but Berta refuses to leave her husband for him. Enne 2 is pursued by the Fascists of Cane Nero and, instead of running away to Turin, waits for Berta to rejoin him.

Title: 853. Bo za
description: A veteran and tough sheriff's wife has a gambling problem. He works both sides of the law. He gets teamed up with a young cop who he is told to take under his wing. They end up working together well and the young cop's martial arts skills are very useful.

Title: 854. S lyubimymi ne rasstavaytes
description: Mitya stops believing his wife Katya. He is tormented, tormented by jealousy, despite the fact that his wife did not cheat. They are getting divorced. Shortly after the divorce, Katya ends up in the hospital. Quiet, with dull eyes, Mitya visits her. Their date is coming to an end. And suddenly she screams, choking with sobs: "I miss you, Mitya!" Suspicions, doubts, jealousy - everything is gone. Only love remained - real, all-consuming, subjected to a cruel test and rediscovered itself.

Title: 855. Albur de amor
description: Leandro, a rancher with two friends, is a ladies' man who provokes jealous rivals. Gloria, a rich widow, returns from Europe pursuing him despite her father's past disapproval. She leaves him for Alfredo after his infidelity.

Title: 857. Stepping Out
description: Forty extraordinary people took to the stage. Labelled by society as mentally handicapped, isolated and hidden away in institutions, they came to the Sydney Opera House and gave a performance that held audiences spellbound.

Title: 858. La sucesion
description: A drama of political intrigue in which some of the most common vices of Latin American government systems are veiled, at least in a hypothetical way.

Title: 859. Van Morrison in Ireland
description: The first official video by Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, showing footage of the band whilst touring in Ireland and images of Belfast, including Hyndford Street and Cyprus Avenue.

Title: 860. Le bar du téléphone
description: Toni Veronese, small strike, attacks the interests of the Perez brothers, mobsters wanted throughout the country.

Title: 862. Gemini
description: Twin brothers fall in love with the same girl and soon find themselves unwittingly entrapped in the plans of dangerous diamond smugglers.

Title: 863. Phir Wohi Raat
description: A woman keeps having nightmares about a woman trying to kill her and a psychiatrist tries to help her.

Title: 864. Hank Williams: The Show He Never Gave
description: On the final night of his life, Dec. 31, 1952, country music legend Hank Williams imagines himself giving a New Year's Eve performance in a small bar, with his comments to the audience reflecting upon his life.

Title: 865. Ciao marziano
description: The inhabitants of the distant planet Gemini send to Rome the extraterrestrial Bix. His task is to transport twelve Earths to the planet so that we can find out if they are suitable for living there. Bix, who's distinguishable from humans only because he has a green face, also has supernatural powers that allow him to repair damages. On the eve of the departure for Gemini, a trap is set for him...

Title: 866. ...Y al tercer año, resucitó
description: On November 20, 1978 a truck driver picks up a man on the road, that tells him to take him to Pardo's Palace. Soon, the truck driver begins to realize who this person is.

Title: 867. Locos por la música
description: A music band led by tries to get record labels' attention.

Title: 870. Drumul oaselor
description: Margelatu, the feared criminal helps the Romanian resistance to fight the dictatorial authorities.

Title: 871. The Moth
description: Jan has his own night radio program where people can simply call and talk about own troubles. The station management does not share his compassion for lonely souls and think the program is useless. Jan has a wife with a drinking problem and a girlfriend on the side who deos not understand him either. He becomes more and more irritated and eventually loses control of himself and ends up in a mental clinic.

Title: 872. Signum Laudis
description: The trenches of World War I provide for a captivating backdrop to the drama of Corporal Hoferik. In his devotion to the Habsburg Monarchy, he fanatically carries out his military orders, but he ultimately suffers the Empire's disfavor.

Title: 873. Shuai ya lao hu
description: A cook is drawn into a turbid and furious treasure scramble accidentally.

Title: 874. Hijos de papá
description: This satirical comedy follows the strict older generation pitting themselves against the pleasure-seeking youths, both in 1947 and in 1978.

Title: 875. Mr. Patman
description: A male nurse working the night shift at a psychiatric hospital begins to lose his own grip on reality.

Title: 876. The Sleep of Death
description: Set in 1815, a young Englishman touring Europe encounters more than he bargained for. His pursuit of the beautiful Countess St. Alyre brings him into contact with the Marquis D'Armanville and other odd characters. A series of bizarre murders occur, bringing our hero to the borderland of nightmare.

Title: 877. The Cruz Brothers and Miss Malloy
description: Three Puerto Rican brothers retreat to a town in New York following their father's death during a bank robbery. There they are hired by an elderly Irishwoman to renovate her house so she can throw one last house party.

Title: 879. Ilegales y mojados
description: A young Mexican man illegally crosses the border between Mexico and the United States.

Title: 880. Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
description: The year is 1756 and the Emperor journeys to Soochow, where he encounters a famous courtesan and gets involved with in all sorts of un-emperor-like activities.

Title: 881. The Mouse and the Woman
description: The story of a man who is as handy with his fists as with his poetic fantasy. His masculinity fascinates Gilda, the wife of the owner of the mine. Gilda is something of a seductress. A story set in the secluded valleys of Wales during the 1914-18 war.

Title: 882. Rabbit sex: Joshigakusei shûdan bôkô jiken
883. A Deadly Secret
description: A young martial artist is framed and thrown into prison. His cellmate is a shaggy convict, who is repeatedly tortured by the local magistrate, and is wanted by all the local martial artists, who all want him to reveal 'the deadly secret'.

Title: 884. Kung Fu of 8 Drunkards
description: Chang Fung is a young man studying kung fu under the perpetually inebriated Wu Tseng, who seems to have made a few enemies along the way. When a gang of four warriors show up intent on killing Wu, it is time for Chang to show what he has learned of his trainer's "drunken kung fu". Will he be able to protect his teacher from the killers?

Title: 885. Cordélia
description: In a little village at the end of the 1890's, a young woman offends all the 'right-thinking' villagers by allowing men in her house in the absence of her husband. When he is found dead, all of the suspicion is directed towards the liberal woman. She is judged more for her morality then for the crime she is accused of. Her culpability is still a subject of debate today.

Title: 886. Les phallocrates
description: A fraudulent builder has planned to spend a few of days in Switzerland to hide his hoard in a swiss bank at once. Unfortunately an inspector of the Internal Revenue department is going to come and go over the firm's books.

Title: 887. Masoch
description: Aurora Rumelin is happy because the noble writer Leopold Sacher-Masoch has asked for her hand. Little by little the marriage goes into crisis mainly because Leopold asks his wife to beat him before sexual relations and to treat him like a slave. Both spouses have lovers and, in the end, the marriage ends in divorce.

Title: 889. Eagle vs. Silver Fox
description: A young man seeks revenge against the martial arts master who murdered his father.

Title: 890. Dadar Kirti
description: Advocate Nivaran Chatterjee lives a wealthy lifestyle in a small town along with his wife, and three sons. His first son is married, while his second son, Kedarnath, who suffered a head injury, is a little senile, and his third son, Amarnath, is a brilliant student. Amarnath falls in love with Beeni Mukherjee, who is a good student, has an elder dominating sister, Saraswati, who is brilliant. Kedar is attracted to Saraswati but lacks the courage to approach her. Then some of his friends introduce him as a brilliant student and athlete to Saraswati's dad, who approves of him. Kedar meets with Saraswati, who also approves of him, and both are slowly drawn to each other. It will not be long before Saraswati finds out that Kedarnath is a fraud, will give up on him, and get ready to marry a wealthy Bhagalpur-based man of her father's choice.

Title: 891. Afternoon Breezes
description: Two young girls, Mitsu and Natsuko, share the same apartment. Natsuko is Lesbian and secretly in love with Mitsu. But Mitsu is heterosexual and has a boyfriend. In the hope of destroying the relation between Mitsu and her boyfriend, Natsuko seduces the boyfriend and also tries to influence him in other ways. Mitsu finds out and throws Natsuko out of the apartment. But Natsuko's love and possession remains. Secretly and never detected she follows and watches Mitsu, in particularly when she has fun with her boyfriend. She even finds Mitsu's garbage bag and eats the other part of a half-eaten apple to obtain some connection with her beloved. She is through and through permeated by a feeling of completely empty despair.

Title: 892. Crazy Swedish Holidays in Paris
description: Barbro and Ulla are two Swedish friends who maintain the myth of Swedish liberty and sexual appetite. Evert and Jan-Olof, their spouses, are not worse, and have competitions about who can give their respective wife the most pleasure.

Title: 893. Il lupo e l'agnello
description: Leon de Paris used to be a modest dog-barber in Paris. In search of more satisfaction. Thanks to the economic helps of Fanny (his terrible mother in law), he succeeds to set up in Roma a very stylish "Coiffeur pour homme". But due to this, his life with Fanny isn't funny, and more, Leon has to dissimulate homosexuality for job reasons. He decides to stop this nightmare engaging "Er Cuculo" (the cuckoo) a B-gangster to simulate a robbery. In fact the plan is to take all Fanny's money, share it among them and escape in Montecarlo. Will the strange couple succeed?

Title: 894. Hordubal
description: After five years of hard work in America Juraj Hordubal (Anatoliy Kuznetsov) returns back home. He is looking forward to his wife Polana (Libuše Geprtová) and his little daughter Hafie. The family and the village welcome him with hesitation. Everybody believed that Juraj died in America because Polana stopped receiving money from him already two years ago. Polana's farm was prospering first of all thanks to the young stable boy Stepán (Sándor Oszter). Men in the pub first indicate and then say to Juraj directly that Polana has been unfaithful to him with Stepán.

Title: 896. Detik 12 Malam
description: A former teacher suffering from mental illness is treated by a doctor, only to discover that his jealous fiancee is the long-lost daughter she has been searching for since her ex-husband took her away years ago.

Title: 897. Shi ying xiong chong ying xiong
description: A shipment of gold, collected as charity, is high-jacked in transit. Two con-men witness the robbery, and become wrongly accused as the robbers. At first they compete to capture each other for the rewards on their heads; but eventually work together to find the gold and expose the real bandits. However, the bandit chief isn't giving up so easily....

Title: 898. The Leg Fighters
description: Tan, a Northern Chinese kung fu expert, kills a man using his lethal bootwork in self defense. He is then hired to train a bratty princess and her servant in kung fu. In the meantime, the brother of the man Tan killed is out for revenge and he'll get him at any cost.

Title: 901. Ixe
description: Eeks is the four points of the compass, the four ends of the cross, is War, Sex, Religion and Drugs.

Title: 902. Nympha
description: Burdened with a traumatic childhood past, Nympha Monteverde has a different kind of sickness, not promiscuity but nymphomania. Whenever she sees a man, she shakes and perspires. There is an uncontrollable fire that burns within her. Will Alma be cured of her sickness, be a normal woman, and have a family in the future? Philippines Filipino Tagalog movie.

Title: 903. Al Raghba
description: Gaber, a wealthy businessman, left Hala following his injury in the 1967 war. Meanwhile, Hala is now married to Hussein and have a child. Despite everything, Gaber buys a nearby villa just to be close to her, unable to forget their love.

Title: 904. Vrijdag
description: Georges, a workman in his forties, get unexpected released from jail after being imprisoned for two years for having passed a sexual relation with his daughter. Once arrived home, he encountered himself in a difficult situation: Meanwhile him being in imprisoned, his wife started a love affair with his best friend, and more, she has gotten a child from him. Georges is prepared to forgive his wife, as a compensation for the crime committed with their daughter, and under the condition that she comes back to live with him. In this complex and emotional loaded situation, Georges and his wife are trying to find back peace of mind and to go on with their lives.

Title: 906. The Line
description: An account of the Presidio mutiny of 1968, in which twenty-seven prisoners participated in a sit-down strike at the stockade in Presidio, California. The protest was sparked by the death of a prisoner, overcrowding in the stockade, alleged mistreatment by guards, and set in motion when four AWOL soldiers participated in an anti-war march in San Francisco. During their morning formation, the twenty-seven men sat down and sang "We Shall Overcome" as their demands were read. The protest ended when military police removed the participants one at a time.

Title: 907. The Handyman
description: Le film, qui sera primé à San Sebastian, raconte l'histoire d'un homme dont la naïveté et la galanterie d'un autre âge sont à l'origine de nombreux déboires sentimentaux, tout particulièrement lorsqu'il s'amourache d'une belle bourgeoise dont il est l'homme à tout faire.

Title: 908. The Wicked
description: A selfish playboy uses rich women to pay off his debts. Divorcing his wife and marrying the woman he loves throws him into a spiral of destruction.

Title: 909. PSI Factor
description: Aliens from another dimension cross space and time to come to Earth. A scientist tries to discover what their motives are.

Title: 910. Aanchal
description: The pure, selfless, and strong bond between Shambu and his sister-in-law Shanti is misunderstood by their family and the society, leading them to face many trials that threaten to split the family.

Title: 911. Fearless Hyena 3
description: A young kung fu fantatic learns the Mngoose style from a drunken master in order for him to send a bunch of mericelss fighters running form the town

Title: 912. Bruce's Fists of Vengeance
description: To compete in his friend Peter's martial arts tournament, Jack flies into Manila from Hong Kong and brings along a book of secret Jeet Kune Do techniques that was entrusted to him by the late martial arts legend Bruce Lee. During the competition, Jack witnesses Peter's defeat at the hands and feet of his academy's rival master, Miguel. Peter gets the book from Jack, just as Miguel learns about its existence. Miguel sends his best fighters to seize the book. Instead, they kidnap Jack and Peter's girlfriend Miriam and hold them ransom in exchange for the book. Now, working commando, Peter uses the secrets of the book to free his woman and best friend.

Title: 913. Gaijin, a Brazilian Odyssey
description: Based on fact, this is the story of the struggles of Japanese immigrants who traveled to and settled in Brazil looking for a better life.

Title: 914. Powder Heads
description: Bizarre conclusion to the Edmonton-shot Canadian ski comedy Powder Heads. In the middle of a big race to determine if the heroes lose their bus, the narrator cuts in to explain the character's futures.

Title: 917. The Enemy
description: Ismail is out of work despite am obvious willingness to do almost anything to earn enough to provide for his family. He is too well educated for the jobs he hopes to find, but not well enough connected to find the work he is capable of doing.

Title: 918. El consenso
description: In a small coastal town a curious war is unleashed between the "virtuous" and the "prostitutes", choosing Carmelo, owner of the local pharmacy, to mediate, which he refuses to have his girlfriend, virgin, on the other side.

Title: 919. Eleftherios Venizelos: 1910-1927
description: The life and work of Greek politician Eleftherios Venizelos from his election in 1910 until 1927.

Title: 920. The Buddha Assassinator
description: A skilled fighter is employed by a Manchu after saving him from Ming assassins, but his loyalty is tested when he discovers that his family have been targeted by the Manchus.

Title: 921. Oggetti smarriti
description: Instead of traveling to Rome, Marta stays at the Milan train station with her husband and lover. After meeting a youth from her childhood, she experiences various encounters until an event causes her to lose her mind and memory.

Title: 922. La guerra de los niños
description: A school closes due to heavy debt which brings the children into action by doing naughty deeds so as to persuade the real estate agency to reopen the school, and since this didn't work, they kidnap the school's owner in order to be heard.

Title: 923. El-Gaheem
description: Hotel worker Ramzi steals the safe to run away with his lover and build a new life but his dream turns into a dangerous nightmare when his colleagues discover the theft and hunt him down forcing him into a terrifying spiral of crime violence and endless running from his tragic fate oh

Title: 924. Taxi Chor
description: Rajesh is a small time crook , He changes his name to Rakesh for other crimes. Reetesh lookalike of Rakesh has to face the law.

Title: 925. Kazaki-razboyniki
description: In Krasnodar Krai, during the first post-WW2 years, a child's discovery of a sculpture in a cave becomes the start of a detective story, in which a group of children from a southern seaside town help to bust a gang of criminals.

Title: 927. See You in the Next War
description: The two enemies from war, Slovenian partisan Berk and German soldier Bitter, meet each other during holidays in Spain. Recalling the war through conversation, Berk remembers Anton, his fellow comrade he had spend the most time with.

Title: 928. Miedo a salir de noche
description: A bank employee, terrified by the crime wave in Madrid during the democratic transition, must cope despite numerous bad news.

Title: 929. Pozorisna veza
description: This movie is partly based on true events, when a group of dangerous international criminals try to rob the national theater in Belgrade.

Title: 930. Sitara
description: Dhaniya and Kundan are childhood sweethearts, and hope to marry once they have attained maturity. Dhaniya would like to have some money in her possession before she marries, so they decide to travel to Bombay, find some work, save some money, and then marry. Upon arrival in Bombay, they find that getting employment is not all that easy, especially when one is unskilled. Dhaniya feels that she is good at acting, and feels she will be successful as an actress. So both try their hand with various Bollywood agents, and after quite a few misadventures, Dhaniya gets an acting role. She surpasses all estimations, and becomes a star overnight. Kundan sees all the glitter and the glare from the outside, but is unable to become part of what Dhaniya, who now calls herself Sarita, has become. Sarita is so intent on saving money, that she ends up spending more and more money, quite unable to save any, and finally Kundan realizes that he has lost her to the artificial glamor world, leaves her, and heads back home. Will Dhaniya and Kundan be ever re-united again? Has success changed Dhaniya?

Title: 931. Dedicatoria
description: Juan, a journalist, has always with him a tape recorder in which he records the interviews he does without judging them, an assessment that he leaves to his boss and friend, Paco. While he falls in love with Carmen, daughter of Luis, whom he tries to interview in prison, he interviews Clara, the beautiful wife of Paco.

Title: 932. Garam Khoon
description: Garam Khoon is the story of Ravi and Babloo who were born twins but lived like enemies. Their father SUD Sahib was a man of reputed integrity and had worldwide business. Sheltering under the goodwill of the concern, Vishal the ccunning Manager, made a huge fortune by dealing with the magnets of the underworld. Until he has caught red-handed and expelled from his services. . In order to avenge his insult and feed his evergrowing lust for money. Vishal kidnapped Babloo and transformed him into a first rate criminal and gave him the name Johny. After his last break-out from jail, Vishal planted him in his own house to do away with Ravi and his properties. Event followed event till Ravi was declared dead in a car disaster at Simla. Johny ccame into the shoes of Ravi and acquitted himself creditably. Even his mother could not detect the foulplay. However to their great dismay, one day Ravi appeared on the scene. The tables turned on Vishal and Johny. A final attempt on Ravis life was made but somehow he managed to escape with his sweet-heart. They were faced with two dangers - One at the hands of Johny and his deadly henchmen and the other crimes committed by Johny. At the same time the mother came to know the reality but she too was helpless. To save one son she had to sacrifice the other.

Title: 936. O lacrima de fata
description: The discovery of a drowned young girl's body makes the local authorities start an investigation.

Title: 937. Nakaw na pag-ibig
description: Peter L. Gan presents a stirring love drama that sets the pace for 1980.

Title: 938. Nancy Mitford: A Portrait by Her Sisters
description: A portrait of Nancy Mitford by interviewing her sisters and her nephew. Footage and sound recordings of Nancy Mitford interspersed

Title: 940. Swift Sword
description: A righteous swordsman marries a girl from an evil clan, and the evil clansmen cripple him and leave him for dead. Years later, a virtuous young man finds him living in a cave and learns his Swift Sword techniques.

Title: 941. Emilio Varela vs Camelia la Texana
942. Kraithong
description: Good old fashioned daft fun with the croc from Sompote Sands' classic Crocodile chowing down on Thai villagers and letting small children jump down his throat.

Title: 943. Maybe Tomorrow
description: A couple in love, but sadly married to other partners. What is to be done?

Title: 944. Verbotene Spiele auf der Schulbank
description: Nora rushes the whole school when she seduces one teacher after the other.

Title: 945. Une nuit rêvée pour un poisson banal
947. Sugat sa ugat
description: A provincial son who just finished law school embarked on becoming a successful man, even if it means leaving behind his former life and seducing a woman beyond his means.

Title: 948. Alibha Daga
description: Indian film directed by Ramaraman Padhi.

Title: 950. Întoarcerea lui Voda Lapusneanu
description: The film depicts the second reign of the ruler Alexandru Lapusneanu, who returned to the throne of Moldavia in 1564 after being exiled by the landowners.

Title: 951. Viaje al más allá
description: A doctor in parapsychology invites some people to their mansion. They all have lived some kind of paranormal experiences.

Title: 952. Othello
description: The Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it is all part of the scheme of a bitter ensign named Iago.

Title: 953. Gibbi Westgermany
description: The story of Gibbi, who so needs his mother's love but cannot have it, that he is driven insane.

Title: 954. Brussels Transit
description: Fictional re-enactments about the early years in Belgium of the director's parents, Jewish immigrants from Poland, and scenes taken in modern Brussels in this elliptical experimental feature.

Title: 955. Patita
description: A story of a woman who is forced to make sacrifices, including adapting to a questionable career.

Title: 957. Istanbul 79
description: The effort of a family immigrating to Istanbul to hold on to the city.

Title: 958. Kai xana pros ti doxa trava
description: A research of a TV reporter about a popular singer shows out all the social and political situations of the 80s in Greeece.

Title: 959. The Rebellious Reign
description: Nin Gang Yiu (Jimmy Lee), after training for the hard time, he decided to go to the outside world and join the 4th prince (Norman Chu) for gaining the king's position. Eventually Yiu alongside with Pai Tai Hau (Alan Hsu) decided to make a rebellion towards the 4th prince for the justice.

Title: 960. Kaali
description: After being released from jail, Kaali is in search of Raja Rao, a rich businessman who is responsible for the death of his family members.

Title: 961. Le rebelle
description: Pierre lives with his sister in the suburbs, struggling to get by while caring for his ailing mother. Unemployed but defiant, he's drawn to a Young Communists meeting-though his spirit is more anarchist than political.

Title: 962. Kali Ghata
description: When a young woman is pushed off a boat, she must unmask her would-be killer.

Title: 963. Ja nebutu si skuka
description: The summer adventures of the teenagers are centered around Karlis, whose rich imagination sees UFOs everywhere.

Title: 964. Chlapi prece neplácou
description: The holidays began and Pepík Janousek is playing with his friend Hadraba, whose nickname is Sun. Sun has to baby-sit his small brother in a pram and envies Pepík his nice adoptive parents because his own father beats him often. Pepík is happy - he will have soon the same surname Marek as his father and mother. Pepík is shocked when Sun tells him that Mrs Marková is pregnant. He falls from a height and ends up in hospital. Despite of all expressed love and care Pepík is afraid that the Mareks will no longer want him.

Title: 966. Maria - Nur die Nacht war ihr Zeuge
description: A Greek taxi driver with roots in Naples and his wife Maria, a waitress from Germany, moves together to Mykonos to build a new life.

Title: 967. O Incrível Monstro Trapalhão
description: Dr. Jegue is a fumbling inventor and scientist, who in his spare time helps his friends Kiko, Sassá, and Quindim in a mechanic's shop. The four are great friends of Carlos Alberto, a stock car driver who suffers from the frames of rival Hugo and his gang. By doing scientific research in his mini-lab, Jegue discovers two powerful formulas: one extracted through the Quince tree, an abundant fictitious plant in the Northeast; and another that turns Dr. Jegue into a big, bearded, moody man with powerful strength. The Marmeleiro formula is tested in a race at the Interlagos Autodrome in the old track and the news of a "new fuel" becomes the main news of the country. Soon, buyers from all over the world come to Brazil to try to buy the formula, offering a lot of money for it, but Jegue, not ambitious, decides not to sell the formula anymore and leaves it in his country.

Title: 968. Arme, syndige menneske
description: The alcoholic Oslo journalist Erik Mogensen goes to Copenhagen to make a story about youth and drugs. Inevitably this goes wrong for Erik.

Title: 971. Bancharamer Bagan
description: Inheriting a dry patch of land, Bancharam converts it into a fabulous garden.

Title: 972. Het teken van het beest
description: In 1928 in the northern part of the Netherlands, a man has an affair with the wife of one of his friends (who is in jail at the time). Because she abandons her children to move in with him, the police are sent to arrest her. This leads to a dramatic confrontation.

Title: 973. Po jie da shi
description: Gordon Liu portrays a Buddhist monk who abandons his post at a Buddhist temple when the temple is attacked by Japanese troops during World War II. After he leaves the temple, he takes on two misfit apprentices portrayed by Eric Tsang and Liu Chia-yung. Together, they battle the villains,

Title: 974. Charlie Bravo
description: After a nurse is captured in Vietnam and held prisoner in a small jungle village, a group of soldiers is tasked with rescuing her.

Title: 975. Angela Markado
description: A waitress is repeatedly gang-raped, humiliated, and left for dead by five men whom she systematically hunts down to seek revenge.

Title: 976. Zalim
description: Vinod Khanna rescues the purse of a pretty girl, Leena chandavarkar which was robbed by two robbers. Vinod & Leena meet and fall in love. One night, a dead body is found in Leena's room and she calls Vinod. Out of panic and desperation Vinod gets rid of the body. The next day police start to investigate, and Leena goes missing. Who's body is this, where did it come from, who commited this murder and where is Leena? Watch this thrilling movie to find out.

Title: 977. Buscando un campeon
description: A group of veteran boxers find a young potential champion to train.

Title: 978. El fin del tahur
description: Luciana, a young, struggling single mother moves to a seedy Mexican town to find a proper job and provide a good education and a decent living to her son. Jaime Gansi a lonely, self loathing, compulsive gambler is obsessed with beat world weary and expert tahur Almada to prove himself and others that he is not a born loser as everyones calls him. Destiny brings together this out of their luck characters and romance blooms: Luciana thinks she found the right man and a father to her son and Jaime thinks he finally found a woman who believes in him. But his unstoppable addiction to gambling threats their new found happiness.

Title: 980. Øjeblikket
description: Drama about a younger woman who is diagnosed with cancer.

Title: 981. Perdoa-me Por Me Traíres
description: Glorinha thought that her mother had committed suicide and that, as a result, her father had gone insane. Her friend takes her to a brothel, where she wants to work. When her uncle discovers her prostitution, he tells her the truth.

Title: 982. Fontamara
description: Fontamara is a village in the Marsica, forgotten by all but God and its inhabitants are called 'cafoni' (boors). Berardo Viola wants to marry Elvira but only after gaining enough money to buy some land and in order to reach his aim he has the idea of going to a great city. When Maria Grazia is raped by the fascists, Berardo and Antonio decide to leave Fontamara and go to Rome. Here they are swindled by a lawyer and afterwards they are invited by an antifascist to a restaurant where they are arrested by the police because of some subversive papers they had. Berardo dies from the tortures and Antonio can only go back to his Fontamara after signing a paper in which he declares that Berardo had killed himself.

Title: 983. Vilkkanundu Swapnangal
description: Rajagopal decides to go to Dubai as an illegal immigrant in search of a good job.

Title: 984. Las tentadoras
description: The female employees at a nightclub goes on strike.

Title: 985. Payal Ki Jhankaar
description: A girl who is passionate about dance is ill treated by her relatives. She runs away from home to pursue her dream and overcomes many obstacles to become an accomplished dancer.

Title: 987. Kelione i roju
description: "Travel to Paradise" - The rich widow Marta Anker, owner of a renowned trading company, loves the poor fisherman Ansa Balciai.

Title: 988. But Then She's Betty Carter
description: Look behind the scenes into the life of Betty Carter. Includes interviews with other musicians (including Lionel Hampton) and some wonderful concert footage.

Title: 989. Nutcase
description: The City of Auckland is hold ransom for 5 million dollars by Evil Eva and her Cronies. Threatening to drop a nuclear device into the crater of the volcano Rangitoto, thus activating it. Chief Inspector Cobblestone is on the case, and so is his son who has just finished building his anti-gravity machine.

Title: 990. O anthropos me to garyfallo
description: The story of Nikos Belogiannis, member of the Greek Communist Party and officer of ELAS.

Title: 991. Kalibre .45
description: THE KALIBRA .45 CALIBER GUN BECOMES A HERO'S INSTRUMENT FOR JUSTICE.

Title: 992. All About a Prima Ballerina
description: An actor and his protege lock themselves away from the world while he rehearses for a part in an upcoming feature.

Title: 993. Hari ng tondo ikaw o ako
description: Another action-packed movie by Rudy Fernandez that will guarantee pure intensity and entertainment.

Title: 994. The Iron Hand of the Mafia
description: The heirs of the old mafia give rise to a bloody struggle to secure the monopoly on organized crime.

Title: 997. O Homem que Virou Suco
description: São Paulo police mistakenly thinks a folk poet and singer is the same man who had stabbed his boss.

Title: 998. Personal Problems
description: A partly improvised story of a complicated marriage, the people surrounding the central couple, friends they're having affairs with, and unwanted family.

Title: 999. Spasatel
description: Student Asya Videneeva, her husband, school teacher Larikov, rescuer Vilya Tishin, residents of a provincial town. A strange interweaving of the fates of the heroes, a moral conflict, the uncertainty of relations.

Title: 1000. Maang Bharo Sajana
description: Chandru lives in a palatial house with his dad, Ram Kumar; mom Sita; elder brother Shyam and his wife. Chandru is in love with Geeta Sinha, the only daughter of wealthy Dr. Sinha, and would like to marry her. Geeta, too is in love with Chandru and introduces him to her dad. Dr. Sinha has no objections, the young couple are then formally engaged and a wedding date is set. The wedding preparations take place in both the households, and soon the big day arrives. Before the marriage could be formalized, Dr. Sinha asks Ram that he has heard that Chandru is not the son of Sita but of a prostitute named Radha. This shocks everyone present, and it looks like Ram has a lot of explaining to do in order to get his son married or else live with this stigma for the rest of his life.
